title: The Wailing
description: As country bumpkin police sergeant Kwak Do-won investigates a series of murders that appear to be connected to a strange, sense-deranging sickness that’s going around, local villagers fix the blame on a Japanese drifter suspected of being an evil spirit in Na’s atmospheric tale of demons, shamans, exorcisms, and animated corpses, steeped in ancient east Asian folklore and Christian symbolism. A sporadically hilarious, brilliantly plotted work of insinuating, creeping terror that turns shopworn horror tropes inside out to create something entirely unpredictable and genuinely disturbing. “Korean cinema has a new genre maestro… A supremely unsettling evocation.” —The Guardian Introduction by composer Jang Young Gyu on Saturday, October 3rd Part of Composed by Jang Young Gyu

title: The History of Concrete
description: Fri, Sep 18: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Edy Modica (actress, comedian, filmmaker), after 4:40 show! Fri, Sep 18: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Rachel Kaly (comedian, writer, actor), after 7:15 show! Sun, Sep 20: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Sarah Sherman after 2:10 show! Following the finale of his TV show, filmmaker John Wilson searches for a new creative outlet. After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, he attempts to apply the same formula to a documentary about concrete.

title: Stake Land
description: “The tentpole film in our production Slate with Chicago-based film Company MPI/Dark Sky, STAKE LAND was conceived of as a webseries when that was barely a thing by writer Nick Damici and director Jim Mickle. An epic, heartfelt post-apocalyptic film made over the course of four months to capture different seasons. Another Glass Eye Pix movie that anticipates many significant projects like THE WALKING DEAD and THE LAST OF US and Mickle’s own political SWEET TOOTH.” – Larry Fessenden, producer, actor. See more and save! Get an O ptic Nerve 3-Ticket Pack ($30 for IFC Center members and $45 for non-members) . Ticket packs are good for any three screenings in the series.

title: Rosemary's Baby
description: “He has his father’s eyes…” Satanists are on the loose in Central Park West in Polanski’s slow-burn thriller, which slips almost imperceptibly from the quotidian into the profane, and gives new meaning to the phrase “pregnancy scare.” Young marrieds Mia Farrow and John Cassavetes make friendly with their elder neighbors Ruth Gordon and Sidney Blackmer, but when Farrow’s abandoned and isolated Rosemary goes into a paranoiac tailspin while expecting her first child, she begins to wonder why everyone is so very eager for her to take her daily dosage of tannis root… A masterclass in slow-building, spine-tingling suspense, aided immeasurably by the dab-handed work of legendary editor Sam O’Steen. Part of Filmcraft: American Cinema Editors

title: On The Road
description: ‘Veneno’, a rebellious young drifter, frequents roadside diners where he sleeps with truck drivers. Urgently needing a ride, he meets ‘Muñeco’, a hard-edged driver who keeps to himself. He convinces Muñeco to take him deep into the hyper-masculine world of long-haul trucking across the north of Mexico. As they travel together and an unexpected intimacy builds between them, shadows from Veneno’s past resurface, putting both their lives at risk. Regular engagement begins Wed, Oct 28 – showtimes to be announced.

title: THE ADDAMS FAMILY
description: When long-lost Uncle Fester reappears after twenty-five years in the Bermuda Triangle, Gomez and Morticia plan a celebration to wake the dead.

title: The Beyond             / Pieces
description: Woe be unto him who opens one of the seven gateways to Hell, because through that gateway, evil will invade the world. Italian horror icon Lucio Fulci unleashes his towering terror masterpiece, a fright-filled, gore-soaked fever dream that follows a young woman (frequent Fulci star Catriona MacColl), whose recently inherited old Louisianian hotel holds dark secrets. Long available only in an edited, incomplete version, The Beyond was beautifully restored & rereleased uncut in the late ‘90s by Grindhouse Releasing and Quentin Tarantino’s Rolling Thunder Pictures.

title: Naza
description: In secret conversations on the rooftops of Tel Aviv at night, the systems behind Israel’s calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza are revealed by the people who designed and operated them. We made this film out of a sense of obligation to use our position as Israeli filmmakers and journalists to examine the systems behind the mass killing of Palestinian civilians for which our country is responsible. While filming members of Israel’s military on rooftops at night in Tel Aviv over the past three years, we found ourselves asking the very questions that were asked by our grandparents’ generation and throughout the 20th century: how does one group of people allow the total dehumanization of another? What do the inner workings of such a system look like? Many of the revelations in the film were published almost immediately as we learned of them, in the months following the October 7th attacks, by The Guardian (one of NAZA ’s producers), in collaboration with reporting partners +972 Magazine and Local Call. The film lets us explore something deeper than we could in our investigative journalism alone: not only the words being said but also those that are not said, the silence. It is up to all of us to break that silence. — Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor

title: FFW: Maya Give Me a Title (U)
description: A gloriously zany and personal film from Michel Gondry told with DIY animation and heaps of charm.

title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
description: The new adventure sees the residents of Mossy Bottom Farm looking forward to Halloween - until the clumsy Farmer trashes the Flock's beloved pumpkin patch. When Shaun turns mad scientist to fix the problem, things rapidly spiral out of control, leading to a wild beast roaming the woods.

title: Tad and the Magic Lamp
description: A family of archeologists find a magic lamp that sends them back in time in this animated fantasy comedy adventure.

title: I Love Boosters
description: A shoplifter who dreams of designing clothes teams up with her friends to target a ruthless fashion boss in this sci-fi crime comedy.

title: Monster Mia
description: All her life, Mia (12) has not only felt out of place in her town, she has felt out of place in her own family. Her twin sister, Marie, is the picture-perfect Primrose girl – permanently dressed in pink and puppy obsessed. Mia, on the other hand, loves skateboarding, quirky clothes, and her scruffy pet rat, Quentin. After one too many problems at school, the Primrose headmistress transfers Mia to the mysterious Rotwood Academy to work on her behavior. Rotwood is nothing like Primrose. It’s dark, bat-infested, and it gives Mia the creeps. The place looks more like a castle than a school. And that’s not even the craziest part. At Rotwood, the students are... monsters! This must be a mistake. Monsters and humans do NOT get along. Mia can’t let anyone at Rotwood know she’s a human or she could be in serious trouble. Her only option is to convince everyone that she’s a monster, too until she can get the heck out of that creepy school. As time goes on, Mia begins to realize that her monster classmates aren’t so different from her former human classmates. She even finds some friends who take her under their wing. Paprika is a vampire and Oskar is a... well, Oskar’s head keeps fall- ing off. Mia has finally found a place where she belongs. But things aren’t all sunshine and roses at her new monster school. Vice Principal Van Vlad has a particular disdain for humans and Mia has a feeling he’s plotting something dreadful.

title: Case 137
description: Set against the backdrop of mass protests in Paris, Case 137 follows Stéphanie, a meticulous internal affairs investigator working on the case of a teenager severely wounded by police fire. As she searches for the truth her inquiry collides with institutional resistance and pressure mounts as the case takes a personal turn when she discovers the victim is from her hometown.

title: Relaxed Screening: Backrooms (15)
description: Twenty-year-old auteur Kane Parsons opens a portal to a horror parallel universe based on a disquieting 4chan message board.

title: Ken Russell's The Devils: The Director's Cut
description: Censored for over half a century, Ken Russell’s film returns in a landmark director’s cut reconstruction that reveals the full power of his original vision. Inspired by the true story of 17th-century priest Urbain Grandier, accused of bewitching a convent of nuns, The Devils lays bare the collusion of church and state through a searing vision of religious persecution, collective hysteria and institutional corruption. The restoration many believed would never happen reaffirms Russell’s incendiary masterpiece as among the most overwhelming and uncompromising achievements in British cinema. Assembled from original camera negative, this 4k restoration is Ken Russell’s 2004 preferred edit. Picture and sound restoration by Warner Bros. Post Production Creative Services, Water Tower Color and Warner Bros. Sound.

title: Arnie & Barney
description: In the midst of a severe drought during the hottest summer the meadow has ever faced, streams are drying up, grass is brittle, and the once-bustling insect metropolis teeters on the brink of chaos. For the ants in Captain Pantz’s platoon, the mission is clear: find water and save the community. But there’s one unexpected twist - the hilariously inept Arnie and Barney have decided to tackle the problem themselves. Determined to find water for the meadow and impress their captain, they abandon their post to seek a water source. But what begins as a simple quest quickly spirals into a grand adventure, when the pair encounter a crafty caterpillar mob boss hoarding stolen water, and Hypnita, a scheming mosquito with hypnotic eyes and a thirst for control. As the stakes rise, Arnie and Barney mount a daring rescue to free their platoon from the villains’ grip and restore water to the meadow, hoping that with a mix of luck, chaos, and well-meaning blunders, they can save the day and become the heroes they always dreamed they’d be.

title: FATHERLAND
description: From the director of IDA and COLD WAR: FATHERLAND follows Nobel Prize-winning author Thomas Mann (Hanns Zischler, KINGS OF THE ROAD) and his actress daughter Erika (Sandra Hüller, ANATOMY OF A FALL) as they drive across a war-ravaged 1949 Germany. Returning home after years of exile in the U.S. and exuding a superhuman gravitas, Mann finds the Germany he knew to be gone, replaced by a country with contradictory ideologies. Erika, who acts as his travel coordinator and translator, strives to pierce his detached persona while quietly struggling with a family tragedy.

title: MY UNDESIRABLE FRIENDS: PART II – EXILE: Chapters 1-3
description: When Russia shuts down all independent media, a group of young dissident journalists must flee Moscow so they can keep reporting and not go to prison. In her riveting follow-up to last year’s awards-sweeping MY UNDESIRABLE FRIENDS — LAST AIR IN MOSCOW, Julia Loktev follows these courageous, sharply funny women (and a few men) as they fan out across a dozen countries, to Istanbul, Tbilisi, Prague, Vienna, Amsterdam, New York, and beyond. Over the course of four years, they continue to report the truth to Russians from exile, covering their country’s war crimes, even as they face death threats and are declared extremists and terrorists—as they find new meanings of family, friendship, love, and home far from the country to which they may never return. (Viewers can follow EXILE without first seeing LAST AIR IN MOSCOW.)

title: Disney Junior Cinema Club 2026
description: Packed with fun for preschoolers and their grown-ups, this interactive big-screen experience brings together some favourite Disney Junior stories from Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+, Minnie's Bow-Toons: Pet Hotel, Marvel's Iron Man and His Awesome Friends, Sofia the First: Royal Magic and Toy Story Toons, in a fun-filled extravaganza! Expect sing-alongs, dance moments, exciting games and magical surprises, where audience participation is a must.

title: Fjord
description: Tue, Oct 6: Sneak preview + Q&A with director Cristian Mungiu and co-star Sebastian Stan after the 6:15 show! Tues, Oct 6: Extended intro with director Cristian Mungiu and co-star Sebastian Stan at the 8:15 show! From two-time Palme d’Or winner Cristian Mungiu, a Norwegian woman and her devout Romanian husband relocate with their five children to a remote, close-knit, coastal town. Their teenage children form a fast bond with a neighboring family as unease begins to simmer around their rigid beliefs. When allegations of abuse emerge, they are forced to confront a system of judgment that blurs the line between concern and prejudice.

title: Halloween (1978)
description: Fifteen years after murdering his sister on Halloween Night 1963, Michael Myers escapes from a mental hospital and returns to the small town of Haddonfield, Illinois to kill again.

title: JIGOKU
description: Shocking, outrageous and poetic, JIGOKU (HELL, a.k.a. THE SINNERS OF HELL ) is the most innovative creation from Nobuo Nakagawa, the father of the Japanese horror film. After a young theology student flees a hit-and-run accident, he is plagued by both his own guilt-ridden conscience and a mysterious, diabolical doppelgänger. But all possible escape routes lead straight to hell—literally. In the gloriously gory final third of the film, Nakagawa offers up his vision of the underworld in a tour de force of torture and degradation. A striking departure from traditional Japanese ghost stories, JIGOKU, with its truly eye-popping (and -gouging) imagery, created aftershocks that are still reverberating in contemporary world horror cinema.

title: The Innkeepers
description: “This was Ti West’s fourth film with Glass Eye Pix and his follow up to seminal slow-burn THE HOUSE OF THE DEVIL. Ti explained that the crew stayed in the Yankee Peddlar hotel during the shooting of HOUSE and everyone felt it was haunted so he wrote a script for the location. But I know that Ti had pitched the idea of two slacker ghost hunters years before. Look under the hood and you see three ghosts of past present and future in this movie, anticipating West’s newest venture, EBENEZER. And listen for me voicing A CHRISTMAS CAROL off camera on the TV. I’ve been told it’s Scorsese’s favorite Ti West Film.” – Larry Fessenden, producer See more and save! Get an O ptic Nerve 3-Ticket Pack ($30 for IFC Center members and $45 for non-members) . Ticket packs are good for any three screenings in the series.

title: CITIZEN RUTH
description: Ruth Stoops (Dern), a poor, drug-addled young woman who’s already had four children taken from her by the state, finds herself pregnant again while in jail. When the judge threatens her with a felony charge unless she has an abortion, Ruth is taken in by pro-life activist Gail Stoney (Mary Kay Place), and suddenly becomes the reluctant centerpiece of an escalating tug-of-war between pro-choice and pro-life activists, each eager to use her as a message for their cause. New 4K restoration by IndieCollect, in collaboration with The Criterion Collection and Paramount Pictures

title: Possible Love
description: The lives of two married couples from different social strata collide in Lee Chang-dong’s brilliantly unfolding narrative about economic precarity, in which a laid-off factory worker and his wife become the camera subjects for a documentary filmmaker. Winner of the Silver Lion at the 2026 Venice Film Festival and South Korea’s entry for Best International Feature Film at the 2027 Academy Awards.

title: It's Alive! George Griffin
description: Head. 1975. 10 min. 16mm. Viewmaster. 1976. 3 min. 35mm. Lineage. 1979. 29 min. DCP. Ko Ko. 1988. 3 min. 35mm. Flying Fur. 1981. 7 min. 35mm. The Club. 1975. 4 min. 16mm. New Fangled. 1990. 2 min. 35mm. Flying Fur Fragments. 2012. 6 min. DCP. A Little Routine. 1994. 8 min. 35mm. Total runtime 72 min.

title: Gentle Monster
description: Concert pianist Lucy (Léa Seydoux) moves her family to the countryside to help her husband Philip recover from burnout. Their fresh start is shattered by a police visit, leaving Lucy torn between her love for Philip and troubling questions about what he may have done.

title: Naza
description: Directed by Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, two of the co-directors of the 2024 Oscar-winning documentary No Other Land , Naza reveals the systems behind Israel’s bombing of Gaza and its mass killing of Palestinian civilians. Winner of Special Jury Prize at the 2026 Venice Film Festival.

title: Tad and the Magic Lamp
description: A family of archeologists find a magic lamp that sends them back in time in this animated fantasy comedy adventure.

title: Wicker
description: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbors, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

title: Closure
description: After his teenage son, Chris, is last seen by a surveillance camera on a bridge over Warsaw’s turbulent Vistula River, Daniel embarks on an all-consuming search. Armed with self-built boats, drones, and underwater cameras, he relentlessly scours the river’s depths. As months pass, while his own family struggles to live with the uncertainty of Chris’s disappearance, Daniel begins helping other families with missing loved ones find answers — and, at times, the closure that continues to elude him. Additional showtimes for Oct 30-Nov 3 to be announced.

title: Wildwood
description: After her baby brother is abducted by a murder of crows, headstrong teenager Prue McKeel launches a desperate rescue mission into the Impassable Wilderness - an enchanted forest hidden just beyond Portland, Oregon. Joined by her hapless but loyal classmate Curtis Mehlberg, Prue navigates a world of talking animals, bandits, and powerful figures driven by grief and ambition. As the pair is drawn into a conflict threatening the balance of the forest itself, Prue must discover strength and belief she never knew she possessed. If she hopes to save her brother and protect Wildwood’s fragile future, she will have to risk everything. From Oscar-nominated and BAFTA-winning LAIKA, Wildwood is a sweeping adventure about love, sacrifice, and the magic that reveals itself when we dare to look beyond the familiar.

title: Monster Mia
description: All her life, Mia (12) has not only felt out of place in her town, she has felt out of place in her own family. Her twin sister, Marie, is the picture-perfect Primrose girl – permanently dressed in pink and puppy obsessed. Mia, on the other hand, loves skateboarding, quirky clothes, and her scruffy pet rat, Quentin. After one too many problems at school, the Primrose headmistress transfers Mia to the mysterious Rotwood Academy to work on her behavior. Rotwood is nothing like Primrose. It’s dark, bat-infested, and it gives Mia the creeps. The place looks more like a castle than a school. And that’s not even the craziest part. At Rotwood, the students are... monsters! This must be a mistake. Monsters and humans do NOT get along. Mia can’t let anyone at Rotwood know she’s a human or she could be in serious trouble. Her only option is to convince everyone that she’s a monster, too until she can get the heck out of that creepy school. As time goes on, Mia begins to realize that her monster classmates aren’t so different from her former human classmates. She even finds some friends who take her under their wing. Paprika is a vampire and Oskar is a... well, Oskar’s head keeps fall- ing off. Mia has finally found a place where she belongs. But things aren’t all sunshine and roses at her new monster school. Vice Principal Van Vlad has a particular disdain for humans and Mia has a feeling he’s plotting something dreadful.

title: The Fly (1986)
description: A big screen love story unlike anything you’ve ever seen, David Cronenberg’s ‘80s update of The Fly is as terrifyingly tragic as its ultra-gooey Oscar-winning special effects are jaw-droppingly grotesque. When an eccentric scientist (Jeff Goldblum) uses himself as a test subject, he soon discovers himself devolving into something not quite human, with disastrous consequences to the relationship with his reporter girlfriend (Geena Davis). Bringing his body horror fascination to the mainstream, Cronenberg crafts a gross-out masterpiece that targets the heart as well as the stomach.

title: Fatherland
description: Oscar-nominated director Paweł Pawlikowski (Cold War, NYFF56) won Best Director at Cannes for his most potent film yet, following novelist Thomas Mann (Hanns Zischler) and his daughter Erika Mann (Sandra Hüller) on a road trip across Germany in the aftermath of World War II. Poland’s entry for Best International Feature Film at the 2027 Academy Awards.

title: Naza
description: In secret conversations on the rooftops of Tel Aviv at night, the systems behind Israel’s calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza are revealed by the people who designed and operated them. We made this film out of a sense of obligation to use our position as Israeli filmmakers and journalists to examine the systems behind the mass killing of Palestinian civilians for which our country is responsible. While filming members of Israel’s military on rooftops at night in Tel Aviv over the past three years, we found ourselves asking the very questions that were asked by our grandparents’ generation and throughout the 20th century: how does one group of people allow the total dehumanization of another? What do the inner workings of such a system look like? Many of the revelations in the film were published almost immediately as we learned of them, in the months following the October 7th attacks, by The Guardian (one of NAZA ’s producers), in collaboration with reporting partners +972 Magazine and Local Call. The film lets us explore something deeper than we could in our investigative journalism alone: not only the words being said but also those that are not said, the silence. It is up to all of us to break that silence. — Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor

title: An Autumn Afternoon
description: Ozu’s gorgeous 53rd and final feature is a return to a favorite theme, the poignant comedy of marriage, with beloved regular Chishu Ryu as a father giving away his daughter and preparing for another, final goodbye. Good Morning’s satire of creeping consumerism has become more bitter here, the feeling of incoming winter chill is sharper, the entire project imbued with a tang of regret—incidentally, the title literally translates to “The Taste of Autumn Mackerel.” Part of The Leaves Are Falling

title: Arnie & Barney
description: In the midst of a severe drought during the hottest summer the meadow has ever faced, streams are drying up, grass is brittle, and the once-bustling insect metropolis teeters on the brink of chaos. For the ants in Captain Pantz’s platoon, the mission is clear: find water and save the community. But there’s one unexpected twist - the hilariously inept Arnie and Barney have decided to tackle the problem themselves. Determined to find water for the meadow and impress their captain, they abandon their post to seek a water source. But what begins as a simple quest quickly spirals into a grand adventure, when the pair encounter a crafty caterpillar mob boss hoarding stolen water, and Hypnita, a scheming mosquito with hypnotic eyes and a thirst for control. As the stakes rise, Arnie and Barney mount a daring rescue to free their platoon from the villains’ grip and restore water to the meadow, hoping that with a mix of luck, chaos, and well-meaning blunders, they can save the day and become the heroes they always dreamed they’d be.

title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
description: In 1972, legendary filmmaker William Greaves gathered an extraordinary group of artists, writers, actors, musicians, and thinkers of the Harlem Renaissance. After more than 50 years, his son David Greaves has completed his breathtaking miracle of a movie.

title: Off-Circuit: The Night is Fading Away
description: Pelu is a thirty-something barely scraping by on his salary as a projectionist at a film theatre that belongs to Cordoba's city hall. After losing his job due to budget cuts, he agrees to stay on as the night watchman, and through a series of increasingly unfortunate twists, he ends up secretly living inside the cinema, surrounded by the films he watches every night. Growing more comfortable in his new home, Pelu begins to form a small community that inhabits the cinema after hours: a group of three naranjitas (informal homeless parking attendants) he lets sleep there, who eventually become his closest friends, and Vale, a former friend he allows to record videos for her OnlyFans channel inside the screening room. But the precarious economic conditions they live under are part of a broader crisis that threatens to shut down the cinema and jeopardise their fragile community. Ramiro Sonzini and Ezequiel Salinas's The Night is Fading Away is a luminous tale of friendship, community, and the power of cinema. The screening on the Friday 23 October will be followed by an in-person Q&A with Ramiro Sonzini and Ezequel Salinas.

title: NAZA
description: NAZA (15) is the new release from Yuval Abraham & Rachel Szor, directors of the acclaimed No Other Land. Filmed at night from Tel Aviv rooftops, this investigative documentary examines the civilian casualties of Israel's military operations in Gaza and the systems behind targeted killings of Palestinians. A Guardian produced documentary, NAZA (15) premiered at Venice Film Festival, taking home the Special Jury Prize after receiving the longest ovation in the event’s history. Its title comes from an acronym used euphemistically by Israeli intelligence to denote expected civilian casualties in an airstrike.

title: Wildwood
description: The Portland-set story follows Prue McKeel, who enters an enchanted wonderland when her baby brother Mac is taken by a murder of crows into the forest’s depths.

title: Fatherland (12A)
description: In post-war Germany, a father and daughter navigate political tensions and personal tragedies on an emotional road trip.

title: ONCE UPON A TIME IN HARLEM
description: August 1972: A reunion of Harlem Renaissance luminaries is held at Duke Ellington’s St. Nicholas Ave. townhouse. Though many of these figures haven’t seen each other in 50 years, sharp memories, vigorous debates, and unsettled scores soon flow through this stunner of a cocktail party, which features (among others): artists Romare Bearden, Aaron Douglas, and Richard Bruce Nugent; composer Eubie Blake; poet Arna Bontemps; photographer James Van Der Zee; and activists Richard B. Moore and Louise Patterson. After organizing and shooting this extraordinary gathering, filmmaker William Greaves (SYMBIOPSYCHOTAXIPLASM: TAKE ONE) was unable to complete the film before his death in 2014. One of the cameramen that day was his son David, who expertly reshaped this never-before-seen, newly-restored footage into “a film for the ages…one of the greatest cinematic works of creative nonfiction that I’ve ever seen.” – Richard Brody, The New Yorker

title: Forgotten Island
description: When two best friends are sucked through a magical portal they find themselves menaced by a dangerous creature and in danger of losing the memories that bond them together.

title: Ken Russell's The Devils 35mm
description: An enduring masterpiece of cinema starring Oliver Reed and Vanessa Redgrave, THE DEVILS is a prescient epic of obsession and corruption - and a defining work of art from seminal filmmaker Ken Russell. Fully restored and presented uncut and unfiltered as Russell always envisioned, the film screens from a stunning, brand new 35mm print.

title: The Thing
description: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot (Kurt Russell) and the camp doctor (Richard Dysart) lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

title: Possible Love
description: Possible Love follows the intertwined relationship of two married couples facing different paths and hidden desires. Mi-ok (Jeon Do-yeon) lives quietly with her laid-off husband Ho-seok (Sul Kyung-gu) and their young son Cheol until a funeral brings them into the orbit of Ye-ji (Cho Yeo-jeong), a documentary filmmaker chronicling laid-off workers, and her husband Sang-woo (Zo In-sung) – a couple whose affluent lifestyle stands in sharp contrast to their own. When Mi-ok agrees to be filmed, she grows close to Ye-ji, and finds herself uneasily drawn to the unreadable Sang-woo. As their worlds collide, fractures begin to appear in their daily existence. Marking his first release in eight years, highly acclaimed director Lee Chang-dong ( Burning , Poetry , Secret Sunshine ) brings his signature nuance to Possible Love , capturing shifting emotions, conflicts, and contrasting outlooks that shape these relationships.

title: CITIZEN RUTH
description: Ruth Stoops (Dern), a poor, drug-addled young woman who’s already had four children taken from her by the state, finds herself pregnant again while in jail. When the judge threatens her with a felony charge unless she has an abortion, Ruth is taken in by pro-life activist Gail Stoney (Mary Kay Place), and suddenly becomes the reluctant centerpiece of an escalating tug-of-war between pro-choice and pro-life activists, each eager to use her as a message for their cause. New 4K restoration by IndieCollect, in collaboration with The Criterion Collection and Paramount Pictures

title: The Shining [UK Version]
description: Jack Torrance (Jack Nicholson) becomes winter caretaker at the isolated Overlook Hotel in Colorado, hoping to cure his writer's block. He settles in along with his wife, Wendy (Shelley Duvall), and his son, Danny (Danny Lloyd), who is plagued by psychic premonitions. As Jack's writing goes nowhere and Danny's visions become more disturbing, Jack discovers the hotel's dark secrets and begins to unravel into a homicidal maniac hell-bent on terrorizing his family.

title: On The Road
description: ‘Veneno’, a rebellious young drifter, frequents roadside diners where he sleeps with truck drivers. Urgently needing a ride, he meets ‘Muñeco’, a hard-edged driver who keeps to himself. He convinces Muñeco to take him deep into the hyper-masculine world of long-haul trucking across the north of Mexico. As they travel together and an unexpected intimacy builds between them, shadows from Veneno’s past resurface, putting both their lives at risk. Regular engagement begins Wed, Oct 28 – showtimes to be announced.

title: Street Fighter
description: Set in 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu (Andrew Koji) and Ken Masters (Noah Centineo) are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li (Callina Liang) recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don’t, it’s GAME OVER!

title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
description: Three friends attempt to communicate with the spirits occupying a haunted house, and become embroiled in a supernatural adventure.

title: Gentle Monster
description: Concert pianist Lucy (Léa Seydoux) moves her family to the countryside to help her husband Philip recover from burnout. Their fresh start is shattered by a police visit, leaving Lucy torn between her love for Philip and troubling questions about what he may have done.

title: The History of Concrete
description: Fri, Sep 18: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Edy Modica (actress, comedian, filmmaker), after 4:40 show! Fri, Sep 18: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Rachel Kaly (comedian, writer, actor), after 7:15 show! Sun, Sep 20: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Sarah Sherman after 2:10 show! Following the finale of his TV show, filmmaker John Wilson searches for a new creative outlet. After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, he attempts to apply the same formula to a documentary about concrete.

One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbors, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. title: HAPPINESS
description: The lives of several individuals intertwine as they go about their lives in their own unique ways, engaging in acts which society as a whole might find disturbing in a desperate search for human connection.

title: The Devils
description: Ken Russell’s infamous adaptation of Aldous Huxley’s book, about the apparent possession of a group of nuns after one (Vanessa Redgrave) accuses a priest (Oliver Reed) of collaborating with the devil, is at long last available in its full, uncensored splendor.

title: Clayface
description: A shape-shifting creature made of magical clay haunts Gotham City, alternating between villain and ally of Batman. Multiple tragic figures have taken on the Clayface mantle over the years.

title: Primetime (15) (AD)
description: A triumphantly unsettling Robert Pattinson embodies Chris Hansen, host of the 2000s hit To Catch a Predator who sets out to make television history.

title: The Devils
description: All screenings on a new 35mm print of the 4K restoration of the film. An enduring, singular masterpiece of cinema starring Academy Award-winner Vanessa Redgrave and Oliver Reed, KEN RUSSELL’S THE DEVILS is a prescient epic of obsession and corruption – and a defining work of art from seminal filmmaker Ken Russell. Assembled from the original camera negative, this new 4K restoration presents Ken Russell’s definitive vision of The Devils by referencing the edit he privately constructed in 2004. The film’s sound has been remastered from original English Composite 35mm Mag Film, transferred at 96kHz, plus other original film elements in selected spots as needed. The Picture and Sound restoration was performed by Warner Bros. Post Production Creative Services, Water Tower Color, and Warner Bros. Sound.

description: At the height of the Cold War, Fatherland centers on the relationship between the writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika—actress, writer and rally driver—as they embark on a road trip in a black Buick cruiser across a Germany in ruins.

title: Peppermint Frappé
description: Chaplin and Saura’s electric creative partnership began with this perverse play on Alfred Hitchcock’s (already quite perverse!) Vertigo, in which meek doctor José Luis López Vázquez becomes besotted with his childhood friend’s bride (Chaplin), and sets about making over a doting assistant (Chaplin, again) at the radiology clinic where he works into the image of the woman he yearns for but cannot have. A delirious and seriously deviant psychological thriller. “I got home quite late and turned on the television; a film in Spanish with subtitles, that I knew absolutely nothing about... It was hard for me to follow and understand but, at the same time, I was convinced it was the film of a great director. I watched the rest of the film glued to the TV set and when it was over I picked up a newspaper and saw that it was Peppermint Frappé.” —Stanley Kubrick Part of The Remembered Lives of G. Chaplin & C. Saura

title: NAZA (15)
description: Cloaked in darkness on the rooftops of Tel Aviv, Israeli journalist Yuval Abraham conducts shattering one-on-one interviews with Israeli soldiers and intelligence personnel.

title: Rushmore
description: Extracurricular-mad but otherwise unpromising 15-year-old student Max Fisher (Jason Schwartzman) is too busy competing (or so he thinks) with sad sack industrialist Bill Murray for the affections of teacher Olivia Williams to survive “sudden death academic probation” in Anderson’s deeply funny, deeply melancholic—and very class-conscious—sophomore feature. A back-to-school perennial, all dressed up in prep school navy blue and the muted colors of north Texas autumn, positively thrumming with the upstart energy of British Invasion anthems. (“Anderson,” noted admirer Martin Scorsese, “has a fine sense of how music works against an image.”) An irresistible, disarmingly original, delicately wrought comic fable. Part of The Leaves Are Falling

title: Fatherland
description: The new offering from Oscar-winner Pawel Pawlikowski Fatherland centres on the relationship between the Nobel Prize-winning writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika, actress, writer and rally driver. In the summer of 1949, at the height of the Cold War, father and daughter embark on a challenging and emotional road trip in a black Buick taking them across a Germany in ruins – from US dominated Frankfurt to Soviet controlled Weimar. Returning home after sixteen years of exile in the US, Thomas Mann has to face not only a divided fatherland, but also deep fracture within his own family.

title: TETSUO THE IRON MAN
description:
A man is mysteriously transformed into a grotesque hybrid of flesh and metal after a bizarre encounter with a scrap‑metal–obsessed stranger. As his body slowly fuses with machinery, he becomes increasingly violent and unrecognizable, spiraling into a nightmarish cycle of rage, obsession, and mechanical mutation.
Shinya Tsukamoto’s debut is a visceral, industrial horror experience, drenched in stark black-and-white visuals, rapid editing, and metallic sound design. The film’s relentless energy and body‑horror imagery create a feverish, almost hypnotic assault on the senses, establishing it as a landmark of Japanese cyberpunk cinema.

title: Resident Evil (2026)
description: Have a bloody good time in our microcinema as Zach Cregger’s newest horror triumph takes over for Halloween Weekend! From the mind of visionary filmmaker Zach Cregger (Weapons, Barbarian) comes a thrilling — and terrifying — reinvention of the Resident Evil franchise. In an all-new story, Resident Evil follows Bryan (Austin Abrams), a medical courier who unwittingly finds himself in an action-packed, non-stop race for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

title: An American Werewolf in London
description: American tourists David and Jack are savagely attacked by an unidentified animal while hiking on the Yorkshire Moors. After retiring to the home of a beautiful nurse to recuperate, David soon begins experiencing disturbing changes to his body and mind.

title: Wildwood
description: The Portland-set story follows Prue McKeel, who enters an enchanted wonderland when her baby brother Mac is taken by a murder of crows into the forest’s depths.

title: In the Shadows
description: IN THE SHADOWS is based on the truly inspirational story of Ramla Ali, a Somali refugee who, without her family’s knowledge, became the first Somali British Boxing Champion. Presented by @civicstudios and Affine Films, IN THE SHADOWS is directed by double Emmy and triple BAFTA-winning director Anthony Wonke and written by Ursula Rani Sarma. BAFTA-winning Jasmine Jobson plays the lead role of Ramla Ali, with Finn Cole as her husband, Richard Moore, and Gershwyn Eustache Jnr as Clinton, Ramla’s coach. Other key Somali cast members include Hodan Yusuf, Suhayla Ahmed, Roda Asha Aden, Mustafa Aden, Moe Hashim and Samater Ahmed.

title: Naza
description: In secret conversations on the rooftops of Tel Aviv at night, the systems behind Israel’s calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza are revealed by the people who designed and operated them. We made this film out of a sense of obligation to use our position as Israeli filmmakers and journalists to examine the systems behind the mass killing of Palestinian civilians for which our country is responsible. While filming members of Israel’s military on rooftops at night in Tel Aviv over the past three years, we found ourselves asking the very questions that were asked by our grandparents’ generation and throughout the 20th century: how does one group of people allow the total dehumanization of another? What do the inner workings of such a system look like? Many of the revelations in the film were published almost immediately as we learned of them, in the months following the October 7th attacks, by The Guardian (one of NAZA ’s producers), in collaboration with reporting partners +972 Magazine and Local Call. The film lets us explore something deeper than we could in our investigative journalism alone: not only the words being said but also those that are not said, the silence. It is up to all of us to break that silence. — Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor

title: CITIZEN RUTH
description: Ruth Stoops (Dern), a poor, drug-addled young woman who’s already had four children taken from her by the state, finds herself pregnant again while in jail. When the judge threatens her with a felony charge unless she has an abortion, Ruth is taken in by pro-life activist Gail Stoney (Mary Kay Place), and suddenly becomes the reluctant centerpiece of an escalating tug-of-war between pro-choice and pro-life activists, each eager to use her as a message for their cause. New 4K restoration by IndieCollect, in collaboration with The Criterion Collection and Paramount Pictures

title: Ken Russell's The Devils: The Director's Cut
description: Censored for over half a century, Ken Russell’s film returns in a landmark director’s cut reconstruction that reveals the full power of his original vision. Inspired by the true story of 17th-century priest Urbain Grandier, accused of bewitching a convent of nuns, The Devils lays bare the collusion of church and state through a searing vision of religious persecution, collective hysteria and institutional corruption. The restoration many believed would never happen reaffirms Russell’s incendiary masterpiece as among the most overwhelming and uncompromising achievements in British cinema. Assembled from original camera negative, this 4k restoration is Ken Russell’s 2004 preferred edit. Picture and sound restoration by Warner Bros. Post Production Creative Services, Water Tower Color and Warner Bros. Sound.

title: Primetime (15) (AD)
description: A triumphantly unsettling Robert Pattinson embodies Chris Hansen, host of the 2000s hit To Catch a Predator who sets out to make television history.

title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
description: Three friends attempt to communicate with the spirits occupying a haunted house, and become embroiled in a supernatural adventure.

title: Primetime
description: Inspired by true events in 2006, "To Catch a Predator" host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history. But when a high-stakes operation goes fatally wrong, his veneered dream of fame curdles into a nightmare.

title: Jennifer's Body
description: "She's evil… and not just high school evil.” A demon possesses high-school It-girl Jennifer (Megan Fox) after she is kidnapped and sacrificed in a failed occult ritual. Bloodthirsty, she seeks revenge through any man who crosses her path, but is challenged when her best friend, Needy (Amanda Seyfried), won´t stand idly by as the body-count rises. Campy, funny, horrific and truly impressive. After initially receiving mixed critical reception, Jennifer´s Body has become a horror and teen cult-classic as queer and female audiences have reclaimed the title. Ahead of its time, the film is still referenced in Halloween costumes, fan-theories, and video edits as audiences are hungrier than ever for the iconic maneater, Jennifer Check! Jennifer´s Body is featured as part of MANEATERS, a season exploring the female supernatural on screen. The season is presented with the National Film and Television School’s Film Studies, Programming and Curation MA.

title: Street Fighter
description: Set in 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu (Andrew Koji) and Ken Masters (Noah Centineo) are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li (Callina Liang) recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don’t, it’s GAME OVER!

title: The History of Concrete
description: Fri, Sep 18: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Edy Modica (actress, comedian, filmmaker), after 4:40 show! Fri, Sep 18: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Rachel Kaly (comedian, writer, actor), after 7:15 show! Sun, Sep 20: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Sarah Sherman after 2:10 show! Following the finale of his TV show, filmmaker John Wilson searches for a new creative outlet. After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, he attempts to apply the same formula to a documentary about concrete.

title: Primetime
description: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history.

title: Film Africa: DEAR AJAYI + Q&A
description: In southwestern Nigeria in the 1990s, sisters Ade and Titi Ajayi live under the shadow of their late father, their lives shaped by very different ideas of duty, faith and freedom. Ade, a devout Christian and the family’s breadwinner, struggles to understand Titi, her younger sister and an aspiring s...

title: UNZIPPED
description: “Isaac Mizrahi as he conceived and contorted the way through to his fall 1994 show, [dashing] around a deserted SoHo with pal Sandra Bernhard; [meeting] with Naomi Campbell, Linda Evangelista, and baby Kate Moss for fittings; and [racing] uptown to an audience with Eartha Kitt... Hair-raising deadlines, delirious Bette Davis impressions, and the hostile but exhilarating act of executing a designer’s vision come together in a work that set the bar for all fashion films after.” – Vogue

title: Fatherland (12A)
description: In post-war Germany, a father and daughter navigate political tensions and personal tragedies on an emotional road trip.

title: I LOVE BOOSTERS
description: A trio of fashion-forward professional shoplifters take aim at a cutthroat fashion maven. It’s like community service. Absurdist crime comedy from Rio favourite Boots Riley.

title: Wicker
description: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbors, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

title: Gentle Monster
description: Concert pianist Lucy (Léa Seydoux) moves her family to the countryside to help her husband Philip recover from burnout. Their fresh start is shattered by a police visit, leaving Lucy torn between her love for Philip and troubling questions about what he may have done.

title: FATHERLAND
description: From the director of IDA and COLD WAR: FATHERLAND follows Nobel Prize-winning author Thomas Mann (Hanns Zischler, KINGS OF THE ROAD) and his actress daughter Erika (Sandra Hüller, ANATOMY OF A FALL) as they drive across a war-ravaged 1949 Germany. Returning home after years of exile in the U.S. and exuding a superhuman gravitas, Mann finds the Germany he knew to be gone, replaced by a country with contradictory ideologies. Erika, who acts as his travel coordinator and translator, strives to pierce his detached persona while quietly struggling with a family tragedy.

title: EC: NANOOK OF THE NORTH
description: Flaherty’s pioneering ethnographic film depicts the struggle for survival of Inuit hunter Nanook and his family. Though rife with staged scenes, anachronisms, and an indulgence in the myth of the “noble savage” (Nanook was in fact an Inuit man named Allakariallak, who hunted not with harpoons and spears but with a rifle), NANOOK OF THE NORTH is a work of great lyricism, simplicity of design, and genuine affection for its protagonists, and its force is undiminished almost 100 years after it was made.

title: Sans Soleil
description: Marker's voyage through memory, history, and video games is a free-flow of images shot largely in Japan (a cat temple, sacred phalluses, horror movies, sleeping subway riders, an animatronic JFK), with detours to Guinea-Bissau, Iceland, and, for an extended homage to Vertigo, San Francisco. An alien travelog? The world’s most profound home movie? There’s nothing quite like it in the history of cinema. “Some of Sans Soleil’s trains carry dozing commuters, others travel to distant planets. The film itself moves like a ride through an ever-shifting landscape, shuttling between dreams and waking, here and there.” —Series curator Genevieve Yue Part of Trains: Local Routes

title: Cría Cuervos
description: Taking its title from the Spanish proverb “Raise ravens and they will pick your eyes out,” Saura’s lauded allegorical masterwork, set during the twilight of Spain’s Franco dictatorship, stars Ana Torrent (also seen in Spirit of the Beehive, in the same series) as a traumatized eight-year-old, second of three sisters living with a domineering aunt in Madrid following the death of their parents, who feels herself to be drifting freely between the worlds of the living and the dead and is increasingly convinced she has the ability to snuff out her adult persecutors’ lives. “Both an uncanny drama of family dysfunction and a historical parable of the end of Franco-ism… [Geraldine] Chaplin and Torrent are both outstanding.” —The Guardian Part of The Remembered Lives of G. Chaplin & C. Saura

title: Fatherland
description: Oscar-nominated director Paweł Pawlikowski (Cold War, NYFF56) won Best Director at Cannes for his most potent film yet, following novelist Thomas Mann (Hanns Zischler) and his daughter Erika Mann (Sandra Hüller) on a road trip across Germany in the aftermath of World War II. Poland’s entry for Best International Feature Film at the 2027 Academy Awards.

title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
description: In 1972, legendary filmmaker William Greaves gathered an extraordinary group of artists, writers, actors, musicians, and thinkers of the Harlem Renaissance. After more than 50 years, his son David Greaves has completed his breathtaking miracle of a movie.

title: Nova '78
description: A time capsule of the 1978 Nova Convention, bringing together never-before-seen footage recovered from Howard Brookner’s archive, featuring William S. Burroughs, Philip Glass, Frank Zappa, Patti Smith, Laurie Anderson and other cultural radicals at the explosive crossroads of punk, performance, literature and the avant-garde.

title: The Edges of Cinema: Book Launch + Little Boy
description: Join us to celebrate the publication of Erika Balsom's The Edges of Cinema: Essays on Twenty-First Century Film Culture with the London premiere of James Benning's little boy (2025). Recent years have seen a panic over the future of mainstream film. Yet in her new collection The Edges of Cinema , Balsom argues that film culture is at its most vital on the margins, where the moving image meets visual art, documentary brushes up against experimentalism, and curators are reshaping established histories. Bringing together a decade of selected essays and reviews, the book explores subjects ranging from computer-generated animation to the effects of digitisation, and from the status of observational cinema to a new golden age of repertory cinema, in order to make a case for the politics, provocations, and pleasures of a less ordinary cinema. To celebrate this publication, join us for the first London screening of little boy by James Benning, an artist and filmmaker central to the book. For some fifty years, Benning has chronicled American hegemony and counterhegemony through an expert manipulation of light and time, giving unconventional shape to histories of settlement, racial violence, land use, and unbelonging. In little boy – winner of the grand prize at Paris's Cinéma du Réel festival – he continues this investigation, using popular songs, political speeches, and architectural models to traverse decades of U.S. history. What are the rules governing the organisation of all these component parts? That is left for the viewer to discern. In Benning's words, little boy is "a film looking at the past to warn about the future, from a little boy’s point of view. A companion to American Dreams (lost and found) (1984).”

title: NAZA (15)
description: Cloaked in darkness on the rooftops of Tel Aviv, Israeli journalist Yuval Abraham conducts shattering one-on-one interviews with Israeli soldiers and intelligence personnel.

title: I Love Boosters
description: A shoplifter who dreams of designing clothes teams up with her friends to target a ruthless fashion boss in this sci-fi crime comedy.

title: Clayface
description: A shape-shifting creature made of magical clay haunts Gotham City, alternating between villain and ally of Batman. Multiple tragic figures have taken on the Clayface mantle over the years.

title: Closure
description: After his teenage son, Chris, is last seen by a surveillance camera on a bridge over Warsaw’s turbulent Vistula River, Daniel embarks on an all-consuming search. Armed with self-built boats, drones, and underwater cameras, he relentlessly scours the river’s depths. As months pass, while his own family struggles to live with the uncertainty of Chris’s disappearance, Daniel begins helping other families with missing loved ones find answers — and, at times, the closure that continues to elude him. Additional showtimes for Oct 30-Nov 3 to be announced.

title: Practical Magic
description: Witchcraft feels good in a place like this. Spend the night with two witchy sisters as they fight for love and their family lineage in this cinematic comfort food classic. Magic is in their family tree and these two sisters are about to take a crash course in sorcery when one of their boyfriends dies unexpectedly. Now they’ve got the police and an evil spirit on their tail, and they must stick together to come out on top. Initially panned by critics, audiences have been falling in love with this witchy fairy-tale for over 25 years. Bring your sis or your bestie and let this magical movie cast its spell on you!

title: THE ROCKY HORROR PICTURE SHOW
description: In this cult classic, sweethearts Brad (Barry Bostwick) and Janet (Susan Sarandon), stuck with a flat tire during a storm, discover the eerie mansion of Dr. Frank-N-Furter (Tim Curry), a transvestite scientist. As their innocence is lost, Brad and Janet meet a houseful of wild characters, including a rocking biker (Meat Loaf) and a creepy butler (Richard O’Brien). Through elaborate dances and rock songs, Frank-N-Furter unveils his latest creation: a muscular man named “Rocky.”

title: THE SCOUT
description: Sofia works as a location scout for a TV pilot filming in New York City. It’s her job to find the homes, businesses and exteriors where the show will be filmed. Driving around the city’s different neighborhoods, she enters the private spaces of strangers to photograph their cozy apartments and eclectic shops, stepping into the fabric of their lives while trying to satisfy the demands of her erratic employers. Over a day filled with these encounters, Sofia witnesses moments of curiosity, vulnerability and quiet tension until her work takes a sudden, personal turn. Drawing from her own experience as a location scout, writer-director Paula González-Nasser captures the poetry and costs of being a young creative. Her celebrated directorial debut, THE SCOUT crafts a contemplative exploration of urban disconnection, following one woman’s journey through other people’s worlds as she struggles to find her own.

title: The Devils
description: All screenings on a new 35mm print of the 4K restoration of the film. An enduring, singular masterpiece of cinema starring Academy Award-winner Vanessa Redgrave and Oliver Reed, KEN RUSSELL’S THE DEVILS is a prescient epic of obsession and corruption – and a defining work of art from seminal filmmaker Ken Russell. Assembled from the original camera negative, this new 4K restoration presents Ken Russell’s definitive vision of The Devils by referencing the edit he privately constructed in 2004. The film’s sound has been remastered from original English Composite 35mm Mag Film, transferred at 96kHz, plus other original film elements in selected spots as needed. The Picture and Sound restoration was performed by Warner Bros. Post Production Creative Services, Water Tower Color, and Warner Bros. Sound.

title: ONCE UPON A TIME IN HARLEM
description: August 1972: A reunion of Harlem Renaissance luminaries is held at Duke Ellington’s St. Nicholas Ave. townhouse. Though many of these figures haven’t seen each other in 50 years, sharp memories, vigorous debates, and unsettled scores soon flow through this stunner of a cocktail party, which features (among others): artists Romare Bearden, Aaron Douglas, and Richard Bruce Nugent; composer Eubie Blake; poet Arna Bontemps; photographer James Van Der Zee; and activists Richard B. Moore and Louise Patterson. After organizing and shooting this extraordinary gathering, filmmaker William Greaves (SYMBIOPSYCHOTAXIPLASM: TAKE ONE) was unable to complete the film before his death in 2014. One of the cameramen that day was his son David, who expertly reshaped this never-before-seen, newly-restored footage into “a film for the ages…one of the greatest cinematic works of creative nonfiction that I’ve ever seen.” – Richard Brody, The New Yorker

title: CLASS OF NUKE ‘EM HIGH (Lloyd Kaufman in person for both screenings!)
description: When first released in theaters in 1986, CLASS OF NUKE ‘EM HIGH became an instant sensation. Its unique blend of horror and humor was cheered by audiences and celebrated by critics. The film spawned two sequels and legions of fans. At Tromaville High School, located a stone’s throw from the local Nuclear Power Plant, the students are getting brighter. In fact, they’re beginning to develop a Troma-green glow. Innocent students mutate into sex-crazed psychos, the Honor Society’s turned into carnivorous, kinky cretins, and the slimy monster stalking the hallways isn’t the principal! Lloyd Kaufman will be here in person for both screenings! The Q&A on Fri, Oct 30 will be moderated by Screen Slate founder Jon Dieringer.
director: Richard W. Haines, Michael Herz, and Lloyd Kaufman

title: Under the Silver Lake
description: Young and disenchanted Sam meets a mysterious and beautiful woman who’s swimming in his building’s pool one night. When she suddenly vanishes the next morning, Sam embarks on a surreal quest across Los Angeles to decode the secret behind her disappearance, leading him into the murkiest depths of mystery, scandal and conspiracy.

title: Seven (Original 35mm Silver Retention Print)
description:
Seven, a 1995 American crime thriller directed by David Fincher, follows two detectives, a seasoned veteran named William Somerset (Morgan Freeman) and a rookie, David Mills (Brad Pitt), as they hunt a serial killer who uses the seven deadly sins as his motives.

Director David Fincher and cinematographer Darius Khondji worked with the lab to create a small number of distinctive showcase prints - see one of these rare original CCE Silver Retention 35mm print that provides a deeper black, higher contrast, and added grain.

title: The Restoration at Grayson Manor
description: This campy queer horror film is a morbidly entertaining combination of classic Hollywood, gothic terror, and high-pitched melodrama, featuring a one-of-a-kind performance from Chris Colfer! The foundations of Grayson Manor are shaken when an accident leaves Boyd Grayson handless and his mother invests in radical new technology to help him. Starring Chris Colfer ( Glee ) and Alice Krige ( Star Trek: The Next Generation ) and directed by Glenn McQuaid ( I Sell the Dead, V/H/S ). So, if you’ve been dying for a deadly dark comedy to end spooky season right, don’t decline your invitation to Grayson Manor!

title: Decision To Leave
description: Park Hae-il stars in Park Chan-wook’s Hitchcockian neo-noir thriller as Hae-joon, a detective whose obsessions over his cases interfere with his daily life. A man’s body is found at the foot of a cliff after what seems to be an accident, until the detective encounters Seo-rae (Tang Wei), the wife of the deceased. From there, Hae-joon falls into a spiral of dichotomy, struggling between irresistible infatuation and reasonable suspicion against her as a murder suspect. The chemistry between Park and Tang generates a gentle breeze of grounding emotional force, tugging the audience into enigmatic spaces where reality and dreams merge, and the only consistent language is love. Park’s portrayal of Hae-joon is executed in powerful ambiguity, harmonizing beautifully with the director’s cinematic language.

title: SCREAM
description: Neve Campbell leads an all-star cast in this iconic slasher thriller that launched the SCREAM franchise and breathed new life into the horror genre. After a series of mysterious deaths befalls their small town, an offbeat group of friends led by Sidney Prescott (Campbell) become the target of a masked killer. As the body count rises, Sidney and her friends turn to the “rules” of horror films to help navigate the real-life terror they’re living in. Also starring Courteney Cox, David Arquette, Skeet Ulrich, Matthew Lillard, Rose McGowan and Drew Barrymore, buckle up for an irresistible killer ride!

title: On The Road
description: ‘Veneno’, a rebellious young drifter, frequents roadside diners where he sleeps with truck drivers. Urgently needing a ride, he meets ‘Muñeco’, a hard-edged driver who keeps to himself. He convinces Muñeco to take him deep into the hyper-masculine world of long-haul trucking across the north of Mexico. As they travel together and an unexpected intimacy builds between them, shadows from Veneno’s past resurface, putting both their lives at risk. Regular engagement begins Wed, Oct 28 – showtimes to be announced.

title: Possible Love
description: The lives of two married couples from different social strata collide in Lee Chang-dong’s brilliantly unfolding narrative about economic precarity, in which a laid-off factory worker and his wife become the camera subjects for a documentary filmmaker. Winner of the Silver Lion at the 2026 Venice Film Festival and South Korea’s entry for Best International Feature Film at the 2027 Academy Awards.

title: CITIZEN RUTH
description: Ruth Stoops (Dern), a poor, drug-addled young woman who’s already had four children taken from her by the state, finds herself pregnant again while in jail. When the judge threatens her with a felony charge unless she has an abortion, Ruth is taken in by pro-life activist Gail Stoney (Mary Kay Place), and suddenly becomes the reluctant centerpiece of an escalating tug-of-war between pro-choice and pro-life activists, each eager to use her as a message for their cause. New 4K restoration by IndieCollect, in collaboration with The Criterion Collection and Paramount Pictures
