title: Thir13en Ghosts
description: Part of our Dark Castle series presented by Justin LaLiberty

title: NAZA (15)
description: Cloaked in darkness on the rooftops of Tel Aviv, Israeli journalist Yuval Abraham conducts shattering one-on-one interviews with Israeli soldiers and intelligence personnel.

title: Peven Everett: Voice of a Generation (12A*) + Screen Talk
Wildwood
description: The Portland-set story follows Prue McKeel, who enters an enchanted wonderland when her baby brother Mac is taken by a murder of crows into the forest’s depths.

title: The Social Reckoning (15) (AD)
description: In this companion piece to The Social Network , screenwriter Aaron Sorkin returns to the Metaverse with a tale of the whistleblower who started the social media reckoning we're seeing play out today.

title: FATHERLAND
description: From the director of IDA and COLD WAR: FATHERLAND follows Nobel Prize-winning author Thomas Mann (Hanns Zischler, KINGS OF THE ROAD) and his actress daughter Erika (Sandra Hüller, ANATOMY OF A FALL) as they drive across a war-ravaged 1949 Germany. Returning home after years of exile in the U.S. and exuding a superhuman gravitas, Mann finds the Germany he knew to be gone, replaced by a country with contradictory ideologies. Erika, who acts as his travel coordinator and translator, strives to pierce his detached persona while quietly struggling with a family tragedy.

title: The Devils
description: Ken Russell’s infamous adaptation of Aldous Huxley’s book, about the apparent possession of a group of nuns after one (Vanessa Redgrave) accuses a priest (Oliver Reed) of collaborating with the devil, is at long last available in its full, uncensored splendor.

title: Naza
description: Directed by Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, two of the co-directors of the 2024 Oscar-winning documentary No Other Land , Naza reveals the systems behind Israel’s bombing of Gaza and its mass killing of Palestinian civilians. Winner of Special Jury Prize at the 2026 Venice Film Festival.

title: Sing-A-Long-A Rocky Horror Picture Show
description: THE ROCKY HORROR PICTURE SHOW SING ALONG is getting revamped in 2027 – for all future shows, CLICK HERE ! The Campest Cult Classic of all time gets the Singalonga treatment it’s been SCREAMING for! Featuring the film, starring Tim Curry, Susan Sarandon, Meatloaf and Richard O’Brien, it’s the most outrageous, riotous, kitsch, wonderful romp ever. If you’ve done The Time Warp before, you’ll never have done it quite like this! The evening begins with your host leading a vocal warm-up before they show you how to use your free interactive props bag. Fancy dress is not obligatory but highly recommended! Please Note : The 15 rating we have placed upon this screening is due to the Adult content of the hosted pre-show which may not be suitable for those under 15. Please Note : This is a screening of the movie not a live stage show. Also this screening may contain sudden loud noises and flashing lights.

title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
description: Three friends attempt to communicate with the spirits occupying a haunted house, and become embroiled in a supernatural adventure.

title: Fjord
description: Tue, Oct 6: Sneak preview + Q&A with director Cristian Mungiu and co-star Sebastian Stan after the 6:15 show! Tues, Oct 6: Extended intro with director Cristian Mungiu and co-star Sebastian Stan at the 8:15 show! From two-time Palme d’Or winner Cristian Mungiu, a Norwegian woman and her devout Romanian husband relocate with their five children to a remote, close-knit, coastal town. Their teenage children form a fast bond with a neighboring family as unease begins to simmer around their rigid beliefs. When allegations of abuse emerge, they are forced to confront a system of judgment that blurs the line between concern and prejudice.

title: The Trouble with Harry
description: The inconvenient corpse, imbued with a sense of tragedy and terror in Hitchcock’s Rope, is the source of borderline-surrealist farce in The Trouble with Harry, his adaptation of Jack Trevor Story’s novel of the same name, a darkly comic tale in which the residents of a small New England hamlet—exteriors were shot on location in Vermont, with the fall foliage radiant in Technicolor—try and repeatedly fail to dispose of a dead body that has appeared in their midst. A rare foray into comedy (albeit of the black variety) for Hitchcock, with Shirley MacLaine, Mildred Natwick, and Jerry “The Beaver” Mathers perfectly embodying a bevy of smalltown American “types.” Part of The Leaves Are Falling

title: The Devils
description: Censored for more than half a century, Ken Russell’s visionary masterpiece returns to the big screen fully restored in 4K and cut to Russell’s direction – the first publicly released version of the film as intended by the filmmaker. Unveiled at the 79th Cannes Film Festival, the definitive version arrives 55 years after the film’s original release. An enduring masterpiece of cinema starring Oliver Reed and Vanessa Redgrave, Ken Russell’s The Devils is a prescient epic of obsession and corruption. Inspired by the true story of 17th-century priest Urbain Grandier, accused of bewitching a convent of nuns, the film lays bare the collusion of church and state through a searing vision of religious persecution, collective hysteria and institutional corruption. In addition to powerhouse performances from Reed and Redgrave, Ken Russell’s The Devils showcases the stunning work of artists at the peak of their craft: Academy Award-winning cinematographer David Watkin ( Out of Africa , Chariots of Fire ); editor Michael Bradsell ( Local Hero , Jabberwocky ); and visual artist Derek Jarman ( Jubilee , Caravaggio ), whose work as production designer marked his feature film debut.

title: EC: MAN OF ARAN
description: Flaherty’s third major film portrays the lives of a family of fisher folk on the Aran Islands off the coast of Galway, Ireland. Flaherty selected the location and subjects because of their isolation as the westernmost outpost of European civilization. In addition, the daily struggle between the islanders and the sea perfectly suited his interests and concerns. The scenes at sea are breathtaking. “His passionate devotion to the portrayal of human gesture and of a man’s fight for his family makes the film an incomparable account of human dignity. Better than anyone, Flaherty knew how to show the true face of Man.” –Georges Sadoul

title: News From Home
description: Akerman was 26 years old and living in New York City, away from her native Belgium and her mother, when she teamed with DP Babette Mangolte to film this diary/essay/poem in subway stations and on street corners, their images to eventually be paired with Akerman’s recitals of her mother’s fretful letters. Arguably this extraordinary filmmaker’s most perfect and poignant nonfiction work, both one of the greatest portraits of a city ever put on film and a troubling, touching depiction of maternal love. Screens in the English-language version. “Though Chantal Akerman’s voice can be heard throughout News from Home, her image is only briefly glimpsed, in a reflection on the train. We can’t quite see her, but others undoubtedly can—men, especially, gawk unashamedly, a reminder that the graffiti-covered subway of 1976 New York was often a place of danger and hostility.” —Series curator Genevieve Yue Part of Trains: Local Routes

title: Fatherland
description: Oscar-nominated director Paweł Pawlikowski (Cold War, NYFF56) won Best Director at Cannes for his most potent film yet, following novelist Thomas Mann (Hanns Zischler) and his daughter Erika Mann (Sandra Hüller) on a road trip across Germany in the aftermath of World War II. Poland’s entry for Best International Feature Film at the 2027 Academy Awards.

title: Nightborn
description: In Finnish forest, Saga and her husband Jon embark on a new chapter as parents. But Saga's joy is overshadowed by a chilling suspicion about their newborn, unbeknownst to Jon, causing a rift as she alone grapples with the disturbing truth.

title: FATHERLAND
description: At the height of the Cold War, the writer Thomas Mann and his daughter—actress, writer, and rally driver—Erika embark on a road trip in a black Buick cruiser across a divided Germany in ruins, traveling from the Allied-occupied city of Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.

title: Wicker
description: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbors, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

title: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre
description: When Sally (Marilyn Burns) hears that her grandfather's grave may have been vandalized, she and her paraplegic brother, Franklin (Paul A. Partain), set out with their friends to investigate. After a detour to their family's old farmhouse, they discover a group of crazed, murderous outcasts living next door. As the group is attacked one by one by the chainsaw-wielding Leatherface (Gunnar Hansen), who wears a mask of human skin, the survivors must do everything they can to escape. * The first 35 customers to have tickets scanned in each of these performances will recieve an exclusive limited edition " I SURVIVED THE TEXAS CHAINSAW MASSACRE" badge. A replica of one's we gave out back in 1976 when we were the first cinema to debut this iconic film.

title: Street Fighter
description: Set in 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu (Andrew Koji) and Ken Masters (Noah Centineo) are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li (Callina Liang) recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don’t, it’s GAME OVER!

title: I LOVE BOOSTERS
description: A trio of fashion-forward professional shoplifters take aim at a cutthroat fashion maven. It’s like community service. Absurdist crime comedy from Rio favourite Boots Riley.

title: City of Masks
description: In this romantic thriller, a young actor begins rehearsals at a haunted theatre and catches the attention of the resident ghost.

title: Clayface
description: A shape-shifting creature made of magical clay haunts Gotham City, alternating between villain and ally of Batman. Multiple tragic figures have taken on the Clayface mantle over the years.

title: Wicker
description: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbors, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

title: Naza
description: In secret conversations on the rooftops of Tel Aviv at night, the systems behind Israel’s calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza are revealed by the people who designed and operated them. We made this film out of a sense of obligation to use our position as Israeli filmmakers and journalists to examine the systems behind the mass killing of Palestinian civilians for which our country is responsible. While filming members of Israel’s military on rooftops at night in Tel Aviv over the past three years, we found ourselves asking the very questions that were asked by our grandparents’ generation and throughout the 20th century: how does one group of people allow the total dehumanization of another? What do the inner workings of such a system look like? Many of the revelations in the film were published almost immediately as we learned of them, in the months following the October 7th attacks, by The Guardian (one of NAZA ’s producers), in collaboration with reporting partners +972 Magazine and Local Call. The film lets us explore something deeper than we could in our investigative journalism alone: not only the words being said but also those that are not said, the silence. It is up to all of us to break that silence. — Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor

title: ONCE UPON A TIME IN HARLEM
description: August 1972: A reunion of Harlem Renaissance luminaries is held at Duke Ellington’s St. Nicholas Ave. townhouse. Though many of these figures haven’t seen each other in 50 years, sharp memories, vigorous debates, and unsettled scores soon flow through this stunner of a cocktail party, which features (among others): artists Romare Bearden, Aaron Douglas, and Richard Bruce Nugent; composer Eubie Blake; poet Arna Bontemps; photographer James Van Der Zee; and activists Richard B. Moore and Louise Patterson. After organizing and shooting this extraordinary gathering, filmmaker William Greaves (SYMBIOPSYCHOTAXIPLASM: TAKE ONE) was unable to complete the film before his death in 2014. One of the cameramen that day was his son David, who expertly reshaped this never-before-seen, newly-restored footage into “a film for the ages…one of the greatest cinematic works of creative nonfiction that I’ve ever seen.” – Richard Brody, The New Yorker

title: THE TOXIC AVENGER
description: Welcome to Tromaville, New Jersey, a small American town, terrorized by criminals. The town’s corrupt mayor sits idly by while muggers, robbers, and teenage punks victimize helpless citizens. Among the residents of Tromaville is Melvin, a nerdy emaciated janitor at the local health club. That is, until he becomes THE TOXIC AVENGER! A gang of thugs devise a cruel hoax that goes horribly wrong as Melvin is cast through a third story window into a vat of hazardous toxic waste. However, an unexpected metamorphosis takes place. As the chemicals take hold of his body, Melvin turns into the TOXIC AVENGER, doer of good, and brutal mauler of evil! The rest, as they say, is history. See the film that spawned the comic book, website, cartoon, action figures, and three sequels to date! Experience the action that made Troma Entertainment a cinematic legend!

title: The Innkeepers
description: “This was Ti West’s fourth film with Glass Eye Pix and his follow up to seminal slow-burn THE HOUSE OF THE DEVIL. Ti explained that the crew stayed in the Yankee Peddlar hotel during the shooting of HOUSE and everyone felt it was haunted so he wrote a script for the location. But I know that Ti had pitched the idea of two slacker ghost hunters years before. Look under the hood and you see three ghosts of past present and future in this movie, anticipating West’s newest venture, EBENEZER. And listen for me voicing A CHRISTMAS CAROL off camera on the TV. I’ve been told it’s Scorsese’s favorite Ti West Film.” – Larry Fessenden, producer See more and save! Get an O ptic Nerve 3-Ticket Pack ($30 for IFC Center members and $45 for non-members) . Ticket packs are good for any three screenings in the series.

title: The History of Concrete
description: Fri, Sep 18: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Edy Modica (actress, comedian, filmmaker), after 4:40 show! Fri, Sep 18: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Rachel Kaly (comedian, writer, actor), after 7:15 show! Sun, Sep 20: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Sarah Sherman after 2:10 show! Following the finale of his TV show, filmmaker John Wilson searches for a new creative outlet. After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, he attempts to apply the same formula to a documentary about concrete.

title: Audition
description: Steering away from jump scares and cheap gore and into avenues of absolute torture and terror, Takashi Miike’s breakthrough nightmare is the kind of rare horror film that affects you viscerally and haunts you in your psyche. Juxtaposing the banality of daily life for a widower and his son with an intense level of brutality and nauseating imagery, Miike weaves an unforgettable masterpiece of the macabre. Not for the faint of heart, but simply a must-experience for any horror-phile, Audition is the kind of movie you never really recover from.

title: On The Road
description: ‘Veneno’, a rebellious young drifter, frequents roadside diners where he sleeps with truck drivers. Urgently needing a ride, he meets ‘Muñeco’, a hard-edged driver who keeps to himself. He convinces Muñeco to take him deep into the hyper-masculine world of long-haul trucking across the north of Mexico. As they travel together and an unexpected intimacy builds between them, shadows from Veneno’s past resurface, putting both their lives at risk. Regular engagement begins Wed, Oct 28 – showtimes to be announced.

title: "Joachim's Dictionary" / THE STRANGE CASE OF DR. JEKYLL AND MISS OSBOURNE
description: Based on a sparse, singular design by Laurence Demaria (Ligia Borowczyk), Joachim defines twenty six words each beginning with a different letter from the alphabet. As with “Grandma’s Encyclopedia,” Borowczyk offers a succession of visual definitions which suggest a doomed attempt at mastering the absurdities of the world. Frequently hilarious, Joachim’s Dictionary is Borowczyk at his most anarchic.

title: Resident Evil (2026)
description: Have a bloody good time in our microcinema as Zach Cregger’s newest horror triumph takes over for Halloween Weekend! From the mind of visionary filmmaker Zach Cregger (Weapons, Barbarian) comes a thrilling — and terrifying — reinvention of the Resident Evil franchise. In an all-new story, Resident Evil follows Bryan (Austin Abrams), a medical courier who unwittingly finds himself in an action-packed, non-stop race for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

title: The Exorcist
description: When a mysterious entity possesses a young girl, her mother seeks the help of two Catholic priests to save her life.

title: Ghost Ship
description: Part of our Dark Castle series presented by Justin LaLiberty

title: Bram Stoker's Dracula
description: Coppola at his most boldly baroque, Gary Oldman wearing cinema’s most iconic updo, a puppyish young Keanu Reeves trying to make his way back to Winona Ryder, and Anthony Hopkins as vampire hunter Abraham Van Helsing—it’s all here in this opulent production which returns to the original Stoker text and draws out the piercing sexual ache and romantic longing implicit therein. Part of Winona Ryder Analogue Youth

title: Blade Runner: The Final Cut
description: While so many special effects spectacles are lost in time like tears in the rain, Blade Runner remains the template for imagining the neon-wreathed downer of the future, every bit as influential in its vision as was Fritz Lang’s Metropolis over a half century before. Working from a novel by cult writer Philip K. Dick to create a film that would become the gold standard for sci-fi noir, director Scott shares credit here with “visual futurist” Syd Mead’s design concepts and synth pioneer Vangelis’s atmospheric score. Part of A Cyberpunk Canon

title: The Exorcist
description: SOMETHING ALMOST BEYOND COMPREHENSION IS HAPPENING TO A GIRL ON THIS STREET, IN THIS HOUSE… AND A MAN HAS BEEN SENT FOR AS A LAST RESORT. When 12-year-old Regan MacNeil falls ill, she becomes violent and puzzles doctors with the personality of a horrifying entity. Desperate for answers, Regan’s movie-star mother Chris seeks the help of two priests: one who has lost his faith, and an exorcist. Winner of 1973 Oscars for Best Adapted Screenplay and Best Sound Mixing, THE EXORCIST remains one of the most shocking and gripping movies in the history of cinema.

title: Category H Halloween Special: BLACULA + MA
description: The Rio’s premiere late night horror club, Category H, returns for a spooky Halloween spectacular: BLACULA + MA. A double bill celebrating black horror villains through two incredibly enjoyable films, join us in screen two this 30th of October, 23:30-late.  A blaxploitation classic, BLACULA tells th...

title: Ju-On: The Grudge
description: A social worker visits an elderly woman at her house. The woman appears deeply disturbed, but that’s nothing compared to the shapeless black void — also known as “Kayako” — that lurks in an upstairs hallway. Quiet, creepy, and with bursts of unexpected intensity, JU-ON: THE GRUDGE combines liminal spaces and creepypasta chills to rattle your skeleton. There’s nothing scarier than not knowing what’s scaring you.

title: Grey Gardens
description: Meet Big and Little Edie Beale: mother and daughter, high-society dropouts, and reclusive cousins of Jackie Onassis. The two manage to thrive together amid the decay and disorder of their East Hampton, New York, mansion, making for an eerily ramshackle echo of the American Camelot. An impossibly intimate portrait, this 1976 documentary by Albert and David Maysles, codirected by Ellen Hovde and Muffie Meyer, quickly became a cult classic and established Little Edie as a fashion icon and philosopher queen. Staff Pick by Bella Baynard, Assistant Manager

title: The Devils
description: All screenings on a new 35mm print of the 4K restoration of the film. An enduring, singular masterpiece of cinema starring Academy Award-winner Vanessa Redgrave and Oliver Reed, KEN RUSSELL’S THE DEVILS is a prescient epic of obsession and corruption – and a defining work of art from seminal filmmaker Ken Russell. Assembled from the original camera negative, this new 4K restoration presents Ken Russell’s definitive vision of The Devils by referencing the edit he privately constructed in 2004. The film’s sound has been remastered from original English Composite 35mm Mag Film, transferred at 96kHz, plus other original film elements in selected spots as needed. The Picture and Sound restoration was performed by Warner Bros. Post Production Creative Services, Water Tower Color, and Warner Bros. Sound.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description: George Clooney and Quentin Tarantino star as brothers on the lam from the law, hightailing it to Mexico with a kidnapped family in tow. But when they stop at an isolated strip club, they’ll have to try and survive From Dusk Till Dawn while battling the bar’s bloodthirsty denizens in Robert Rodriguez’s pulpy, stylish & hyper-violent cross-genre blast penned by its co-star. Featuring Harvey Keitel, Juliette Lewis & Salma Hayek plus an all-star cast of character actor greats including Cheech Marin, Fred Williamson, Danny Trejo and Tom Savini!

title: Trick 'r Treat
description: Five interwoven stories that occur on Halloween: An everyday high school principal has a secret life as a serial killer; a college virgin might have just met the guy for her; a group of teenagers pull a mean prank; a woman who loathes the night has to contend with her holiday-obsessed husband; and a mean old man meets his match with a demonic, supernatural trick-or-treater.

title: Hellraiser
description: “We have such sights to show you…” In horror polymath Clive Barker’s adaptation of his novella The Hellbound Heart , horny hedonist Uncle Frank plays with a mysterious puzzle box, summons the Cenobites (led by Doug Bradley in an iconic performance) and endangers his unsuspecting niece (Ashley Laurence). A work of remarkable specificity and imagination, this inimitable, hot and bothered horror landmark is presented in a new 4K restoration. “The best horror film ever to be made in Britain.” – Melody Maker Opens Wed Oct 21, showtimes to be announced.

title: House on Haunted Hill
description: Part of our Dark Castle series presented by Justin LaLiberty

title: The Beyond             / Pieces
description: Woe be unto him who opens one of the seven gateways to Hell, because through that gateway, evil will invade the world. Italian horror icon Lucio Fulci unleashes his towering terror masterpiece, a fright-filled, gore-soaked fever dream that follows a young woman (frequent Fulci star Catriona MacColl), whose recently inherited old Louisianian hotel holds dark secrets. Long available only in an edited, incomplete version, The Beyond was beautifully restored & rereleased uncut in the late ‘90s by Grindhouse Releasing and Quentin Tarantino’s Rolling Thunder Pictures.

title: The Bride of Frankenstein
description: Mary Shelley reveals the main characters of her novel survived: Dr. Frankenstein, goaded by an even madder scientist, builds his monster a mate.

title: Perfect Blue
description: A young Japanese singer is encouraged by her agent to quit singing and pursue an acting career, beginning with a role in a murder mystery TV show.

title: The Thing
description: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot (Kurt Russell) and the camp doctor (Richard Dysart) lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

title: The History of Concrete
description: Fri, Sep 18: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Edy Modica (actress, comedian, filmmaker), after 4:40 show! Fri, Sep 18: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Rachel Kaly (comedian, writer, actor), after 7:15 show! Sun, Sep 20: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Sarah Sherman after 2:10 show! After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, he attempts to apply the same formula to a documentary about concrete.

title: Fjord
description: Tue, Oct 6: Sneak preview + Q&A with director Cristian Mungiu and co-star Sebastian Stan after the 6:15 show! Tues, Oct 6: Extended intro with director Cristian Mungiu and co-star Sebastian Stan at the 8:15 show! From two-time Palme d’Or winner Cristian Mungiu, a Norwegian woman and her devout Romanian husband relocate with their five children to a remote, close-knit, coastal town. Their teenage children form a fast bond with a neighboring family as unease begins to simmer around their rigid beliefs. When allegations of abuse emerge, they are forced to confront a system of judgment that blurs the line between concern and prejudice.

title: Primetime
description: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history.

We made this film out of a sense of obligation to use our position as Israeli filmmakers and journalists to examine the systems behind the mass killing of Palestinian civilians for which our country is responsible. title: The Witches
description: Accessible screening On the last Saturday of every month, the museum's Family Matinee is an accessible screening where we offer open captioning, keep the theater dimly lit, and maintain a lower volume for viewers who are neurodiverse. They walk among us, often appearing as ordinary women, but when one notices those purple eyes, gloved hands, and keen smell for children, it can mean only one thing: a witch. Luke, an orphaned 9-year-old, is vacationing in a seaside hotel with his grandma. So is an undercover witch convention. After the Grand High Witch turns Luke into a mouse, he finds himself scurrying to save the rest of the world’s children from a similar fate. This wicked tale, adapted from Roald Dahl’s children’s novel of the same name, features the work of Jim Henson’s Creature Shop in the iconic and terrifying reveal of the witches' true forms, and an unforgettable performance by Anjelica Huston as the Grand High Witch.
director: Nicolas Roeg PRODUCED BY: Mark Shivas

title: On The Road
description: ‘Veneno’, a rebellious young drifter, frequents roadside diners where he sleeps with truck drivers. Urgently needing a ride, he meets ‘Muñeco’, a hard-edged driver who keeps to himself. He convinces Muñeco to take him deep into the hyper-masculine world of long-haul trucking across the north of Mexico. As they travel together and an unexpected intimacy builds between them, shadows from Veneno’s past resurface, putting both their lives at risk. Regular engagement begins Wed, Oct 28 – showtimes to be announced.

title: COCO
description: “Young scamp Miguel (Anthony Gonzalez) shines shoes by day and worships at his secret hand-built shrine to peacocking troubadour Erenesto de la Cruz (Benjamin Bratt) at night. By strange quirk, his family abide by a strict no music policy, down to a romantic altercation from a few generations past. Miguel is transported to the Land of the Dead on—coincidentally—the annual Day of the Dead, where he must learn a few lessons about pride and the importance of memory before he’s able to return back to the nest.” – Little White Lies

title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
description: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom sees the residents of Mossy Bottom Farm looking forward to Halloween – until the…

title: Parent & Baby Screening: Primetime (15) (AD)
description: A triumphantly unsettling Robert Pattinson embodies Chris Hansen, host of the 2000s hit To Catch a Predator who sets out to make television history.

title: The Devils
description: All screenings on a new 35mm print of the 4K restoration of the film. An enduring, singular masterpiece of cinema starring Academy Award-winner Vanessa Redgrave and Oliver Reed, KEN RUSSELL’S THE DEVILS is a prescient epic of obsession and corruption – and a defining work of art from seminal filmmaker Ken Russell. Assembled from the original camera negative, this new 4K restoration presents Ken Russell’s definitive vision of The Devils by referencing the edit he privately constructed in 2004. title: Paw Patrol 3: The Dino Movie
description: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island Sunday 2nd Aug 11am Charity Screening All proceeds from this performance will be donated to MEDICINEMA Cinema-based healthcare programmes inside hospitals

title: Tad and the Magic Lamp
description: A family of archeologists find a magic lamp that sends them back in time in this animated fantasy comedy adventure.

title: Monster Mia
description: All her life, Mia (12) has not only felt out of place in her town, she has felt out of place in her own family. Her twin sister, Marie, is the picture-perfect Primrose girl – permanently dressed in pink and puppy obsessed. Mia, on the other hand, loves skateboarding, quirky clothes, and her scruffy pet rat, Quentin. After one too many problems at school, the Primrose headmistress transfers Mia to the mysterious Rotwood Academy to work on her behavior. Rotwood is nothing like Primrose. It’s dark, bat-infested, and it gives Mia the creeps. The place looks more like a castle than a school. And that’s not even the craziest part. At Rotwood, the students are... monsters! This must be a mistake. Monsters and humans do NOT get along. Mia can’t let anyone at Rotwood know she’s a human or she could be in serious trouble. Her only option is to convince everyone that she’s a monster, too until she can get the heck out of that creepy school. As time goes on, Mia begins to realize that her monster classmates aren’t so different from her former human classmates. She even finds some friends who take her under their wing. Paprika is a vampire and Oskar is a... well, Oskar’s head keeps fall- ing off. Mia has finally found a place where she belongs. But things aren’t all sunshine and roses at her new monster school. Vice Principal Van Vlad has a particular disdain for humans and Mia has a feeling he’s plotting something dreadful.

title: Saturday Afternoon Cartoons: Time for Halloween
description: Saturday Afternoon Cartoons is New York City’s prime theatrical showcase of early and classic animated cartoons, shown in vintage 16mm film prints from the personal archives of historian Tommy José Stathes. Beginning more than 25 years ago as a casual effort to find and see early cartoons that were unavailable on home video, Stathes’s collection has grown to become one of the largest of its kind. It includes many titles and ‘orphan films’ that are difficult to access or view elsewhere. Stathes joins Metrograph at the end of October with Time For Halloween, a spooky selection of vintage family-friendly animated shorts to usher in the holiday. Come enjoy a crop of musically inclined skeletons enjoying a midnight graveyard dance; a human artist innocently 'haunting' his cartoon canine companion for a laugh; a little boy telling his younger brother a ghost story by the fireplace; a famous flapper hosting a Halloween house party; and other amusing tales. Spanning the 1920s through the ’50s, this assortment showcases classic characters such as Casper the Friendly Ghost, Popeye, Betty Boop, and others. Featuring introduction and Q&A with Stathes on Saturday, October 31st Part of Screen Time at Metrograph

title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
description: In 1972, legendary filmmaker William Greaves gathered an extraordinary group of artists, writers, actors, musicians, and thinkers of the Harlem Renaissance. After more than 50 years, his son David Greaves has completed his breathtaking miracle of a movie.

title: Naza
description: Directed by Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, two of the co-directors of the 2024 Oscar-winning documentary No Other Land , Naza reveals the systems behind Israel’s bombing of Gaza and its mass killing of Palestinian civilians. Winner of Special Jury Prize at the 2026 Venice Film Festival.

title: The Shining [UK Version]
description: Jack Torrance (Jack Nicholson) becomes winter caretaker at the isolated Overlook Hotel in Colorado, hoping to cure his writer's block. He settles in along with his wife, Wendy (Shelley Duvall), and his son, Danny (Danny Lloyd), who is plagued by psychic premonitions. As Jack's writing goes nowhere and Danny's visions become more disturbing, Jack discovers the hotel's dark secrets and begins to unravel into a homicidal maniac hell-bent on terrorizing his family.

title: Fatherland
description: Oscar-nominated director Paweł Pawlikowski (Cold War, NYFF56) won Best Director at Cannes for his most potent film yet, following novelist Thomas Mann (Hanns Zischler) and his daughter Erika Mann (Sandra Hüller) on a road trip across Germany in the aftermath of World War II. Poland’s entry for Best International Feature Film at the 2027 Academy Awards.

title: Arnie & Barney
description: In the midst of a severe drought during the hottest summer the meadow has ever faced, streams are drying up, grass is brittle, and the once-bustling insect metropolis teeters on the brink of chaos. For the ants in Captain Pantz’s platoon, the mission is clear: find water and save the community. But there’s one unexpected twist - the hilariously inept Arnie and Barney have decided to tackle the problem themselves. Determined to find water for the meadow and impress their captain, they abandon their post to seek a water source. But what begins as a simple quest quickly spirals into a grand adventure, when the pair encounter a crafty caterpillar mob boss hoarding stolen water, and Hypnita, a scheming mosquito with hypnotic eyes and a thirst for control. As the stakes rise, Arnie and Barney mount a daring rescue to free their platoon from the villains’ grip and restore water to the meadow, hoping that with a mix of luck, chaos, and well-meaning blunders, they can save the day and become the heroes they always dreamed they’d be.

title: Forgotten Island
description: When two best friends are sucked through a magical portal they find themselves menaced by a dangerous creature and in danger of losing the memories that bond them together.

title: FATHERLAND
description: From the director of IDA and COLD WAR: FATHERLAND follows Nobel Prize-winning author Thomas Mann (Hanns Zischler, KINGS OF THE ROAD) and his actress daughter Erika (Sandra Hüller, ANATOMY OF A FALL) as they drive across a war-ravaged 1949 Germany. Returning home after years of exile in the U.S. and exuding a superhuman gravitas, Mann finds the Germany he knew to be gone, replaced by a country with contradictory ideologies. Erika, who acts as his travel coordinator and translator, strives to pierce his detached persona while quietly struggling with a family tragedy.

title: MY UNDESIRABLE FRIENDS: PART II – EXILE: Chapters 1-3
description: When Russia shuts down all independent media, a group of young dissident journalists must flee Moscow so they can keep reporting and not go to prison. In her riveting follow-up to last year’s awards-sweeping MY UNDESIRABLE FRIENDS — LAST AIR IN MOSCOW, Julia Loktev follows these courageous, sharply funny women (and a few men) as they fan out across a dozen countries, to Istanbul, Tbilisi, Prague, Vienna, Amsterdam, New York, and beyond. Over the course of four years, they continue to report the truth to Russians from exile, covering their country’s war crimes, even as they face death threats and are declared extremists and terrorists—as they find new meanings of family, friendship, love, and home far from the country to which they may never return. (Viewers can follow EXILE without first seeing LAST AIR IN MOSCOW.)

title: Disney Junior Cinema Club 2026
description: Packed with fun for preschoolers and their grown-ups, this interactive big-screen experience brings together some favourite Disney Junior stories from Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+, Minnie's Bow-Toons: Pet Hotel, Marvel's Iron Man and His Awesome Friends, Sofia the First: Royal Magic and Toy Story Toons, in a fun-filled extravaganza! Expect sing-alongs, dance moments, exciting games and magical surprises, where audience participation is a must.

title: Fjord (Open Captioning)
description: Tue, Oct 6: Sneak preview + Q&A with director Cristian Mungiu and co-star Sebastian Stan after the 6:15 show! Tues, Oct 6: Extended intro with director Cristian Mungiu and co-star Sebastian Stan at the 8:15 show! Please note that there are additional showtimes of FJORD that screen without open captions (on-screen display of dialogue and sounds). For those showtimes, click here. From two-time Palme d’Or winner Cristian Mungiu, a Norwegian woman and her devout Romanian husband relocate with their five children to a remote, close-knit, coastal town. Their teenage children form a fast bond with a neighboring family as unease begins to simmer around their rigid beliefs. When allegations of abuse emerge, they are forced to confront a system of judgment that blurs the line between concern and prejudice.

title: Friday The 13th
description: A group of teenage camp counselors attempt to re-open an abandoned summer camp with a tragic past, but they are stalked by a mysterious, relentless killer.

title: Poltergeist
description: The Freelings’ suburban home becomes the center of paranormal activity that opens a portal to the ‘other side’. With help, they must cross over to get their daughter back.

title: THE HAUNTING
description: Paranormal researcher Richard Johnson leads a team of clairvoyants (Julie Harris, Claire Bloom) to determine if the notorious, bad karma-filled Hill House is truly haunted. What he doesn’t bargain for is intensely neurotic Harris developing an unhealthy sensitivity to the mansion’s evil-charged atmosphere. Based on Shirley Jackson’s novel The Haunting of Hill House , this is one of the all-time classics of the genre.

title: THE INNOCENTS
description: Deborah Kerr brilliantly plays a repressed governess convinced that ghosts haunt the mansion and grounds of her innocent young charges (Martin Stephens, Pamela Franklin). Jack Clayton’s gothic psychological thriller was inspired by Henry James’ “The Turn of the Screw” and adapted with the help of Truman Capote.

title: I Sell The Dead
description: “ Glenn McQuaid’s movie started out as a low budget period romp but expanded as Glass Eye Pix producer Peter Phok ambitiously attached actors like Dom Monaghan who started working on our movie the day his character’s demise on LOST aired. A lovely cast includes Angus Scrimm from PHANTASM who had become a Glass Eye Regular (AUTOMATONS, SATAN HATES YOU, TALES FROM BEYOND THE PALE) and Glass Eye stalwart John Speredakos (WENDIGO, STRAY BULLETS, CRUMB CATCHER etc). Glenn’s latest film THE RESTORATION OF GRAYSON MANOR is currently in theaters.” – Larry Fessenden, producer, actor See more and save! Get an O ptic Nerve 3-Ticket Pack ($30 for IFC Center members and $45 for non-members) . Ticket packs are good for any three screenings in the series.

title: Possible Love
description: The lives of two married couples from different social strata collide in Lee Chang-dong’s brilliantly unfolding narrative about economic precarity, in which a laid-off factory worker and his wife become the camera subjects for a documentary filmmaker. Winner of the Silver Lion at the 2026 Venice Film Festival and South Korea’s entry for Best International Feature Film at the 2027 Academy Awards.

title: Gentle Monster
description: Concert pianist Lucy (Léa Seydoux) moves her family to the countryside to help her husband Philip recover from burnout. Their fresh start is shattered by a police visit, leaving Lucy torn between her love for Philip and troubling questions about what he may have done.

title: Wildwood
description: After her baby brother is abducted by a murder of crows, headstrong teenager Prue McKeel launches a desperate rescue mission into the Impassable Wilderness - an enchanted forest hidden just beyond Portland, Oregon. Joined by her hapless but loyal classmate Curtis Mehlberg, Prue navigates a world of talking animals, bandits, and powerful figures driven by grief and ambition. As the pair is drawn into a conflict threatening the balance of the forest itself, Prue must discover strength and belief she never knew she possessed. If she hopes to save her brother and protect Wildwood’s fragile future, she will have to risk everything. From Oscar-nominated and BAFTA-winning LAIKA, Wildwood is a sweeping adventure about love, sacrifice, and the magic that reveals itself when we dare to look beyond the familiar.

title: CITIZEN RUTH
description: Ruth Stoops (Dern), a poor, drug-addled young woman who’s already had four children taken from her by the state, finds herself pregnant again while in jail. When the judge threatens her with a felony charge unless she has an abortion, Ruth is taken in by pro-life activist Gail Stoney (Mary Kay Place), and suddenly becomes the reluctant centerpiece of an escalating tug-of-war between pro-choice and pro-life activists, each eager to use her as a message for their cause. New 4K restoration by IndieCollect, in collaboration with The Criterion Collection and Paramount Pictures

title: NAZA
description: NAZA (15) is the new release from Yuval Abraham & Rachel Szor, directors of the acclaimed No Other Land. Filmed at night from Tel Aviv rooftops, this investigative documentary examines the civilian casualties of Israel's military operations in Gaza and the systems behind targeted killings of Palestinians. A Guardian produced documentary, NAZA (15) premiered at Venice Film Festival, taking home the Special Jury Prize after receiving the longest ovation in the event’s history. Its title comes from an acronym used euphemistically by Israeli intelligence to denote expected civilian casualties in an airstrike.

title: Tad and the Magic Lamp
description: A family of archeologists find a magic lamp that sends them back in time in this animated fantasy comedy adventure.

title: Closure
description: After his teenage son, Chris, is last seen by a surveillance camera on a bridge over Warsaw’s turbulent Vistula River, Daniel embarks on an all-consuming search. Armed with self-built boats, drones, and underwater cameras, he relentlessly scours the river’s depths. As months pass, while his own family struggles to live with the uncertainty of Chris’s disappearance, Daniel begins helping other families with missing loved ones find answers — and, at times, the closure that continues to elude him. Additional showtimes for Oct 30-Nov 3 to be announced.

title: FFW: Singing in the Rain (U) + Intro
Monster Mia
description: All her life, Mia (12) has not only felt out of place in her town, she has felt out of place in her own family. Her twin sister, Marie, is the picture-perfect Primrose girl – permanently dressed in pink and puppy obsessed. Mia, on the other hand, loves skateboarding, quirky clothes, and her scruffy pet rat, Quentin. After one too many problems at school, the Primrose headmistress transfers Mia to the mysterious Rotwood Academy to work on her behavior. Rotwood is nothing like Primrose. It’s dark, bat-infested, and it gives Mia the creeps. The place looks more like a castle than a school. And that’s not even the craziest part. At Rotwood, the students are... monsters! This must be a mistake. Monsters and humans do NOT get along. Mia can’t let anyone at Rotwood know she’s a human or she could be in serious trouble. Her only option is to convince everyone that she’s a monster, too until she can get the heck out of that creepy school. As time goes on, Mia begins to realize that her monster classmates aren’t so different from her former human classmates. She even finds some friends who take her under their wing. Paprika is a vampire and Oskar is a... well, Oskar’s head keeps fall- ing off. Mia has finally found a place where she belongs. But things aren’t all sunshine and roses at her new monster school. Vice Principal Van Vlad has a particular disdain for humans and Mia has a feeling he’s plotting something dreadful.

title: Beetlejuice
description: Tim Burton’s afterlife spooktacular is an energetic mix of goth fantasy and laugh-out-loud comedy! When two newlyweds (Geena Davis & Alec Baldwin) die in a car accident, they must haunt their recently departed home and scare away the obnoxious replacement residents (Jeffrey Jones & Catherine O’Hara), while befriending the new tenants’ teenage daughter (Winona Ryder). But they get more trouble than they bargained for when they recruit Michael Keaton’s rambunctious “bio-exorcist” Beetlejuice to help.

title: The Curse of Frankenstein
description: Cherished by no less a personage than Martin Scorsese for its “totally uncalled for” graphic violence, The Curse of Frankenstein was a watershed film for both Fisher and Hammer, earning 30 times its budget back in the US alone and establishing the studio as the world’s preeminent purveyor of Gothic horror. Awaiting the guillotine, Victor Frankenstein (Peter Cushing) ruminates on the catastrophic fallout of his attempt at creating an exemplary being from scavenged bits of the dead, which results in his cracked creation (Christopher Lee) going on a murderous rampage. Extravagantly colorful, generous with the gruesomeness, and performed with zest—all the hallmarks of Hammer in its prime are in place here, in a shining new 4K restoration. Part of Terence Fisher: Hammer's Master Smith

title: Fatherland
description: Oscar-nominated director Paweł Pawlikowski (Cold War, NYFF56) won Best Director at Cannes for his most potent film yet, following novelist Thomas Mann (Hanns Zischler) and his daughter Erika Mann (Sandra Hüller) on a road trip across Germany in the aftermath of World War II. Poland’s entry for Best International Feature Film at the 2027 Academy Awards.

title: Nova '78
description: A time capsule of the 1978 Nova Convention, bringing together never-before-seen footage recovered from Howard Brookner’s archive, featuring William S. Burroughs, Philip Glass, Frank Zappa, Patti Smith, Laurie Anderson and other cultural radicals at the explosive crossroads of punk, performance, literature and the avant-garde.

title: HACKNEY CHILDREN'S FILM FEST: THE LITTLE VAMPIRE
description: Hackney Children’s Film Festival | Sat 24 - Sat 31 October Tickets £5 or £3 with a Hackney Library Card A Rio Cinema Project  The kids have waited long enough! This October half term, the Rio brings Hackney its first ever Children's Film Festival, with a lively and enchanting film programme curated ...

title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
Naza
description: In secret conversations on the rooftops of Tel Aviv at night, the systems behind Israel’s calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza are revealed by the people who designed and operated them. We made this film out of a sense of obligation to use our position as Israeli filmmakers and journalists to examine the systems behind the mass killing of Palestinian civilians for which our country is responsible. While filming members of Israel’s military on rooftops at night in Tel Aviv over the past three years, we found ourselves asking the very questions that were asked by our grandparents’ generation and throughout the 20th century: how does one group of people allow the total dehumanization of another? What do the inner workings of such a system look like? Many of the revelations in the film were published almost immediately as we learned of them, in the months following the October 7th attacks, by The Guardian (one of NAZA ’s producers), in collaboration with reporting partners +972 Magazine and Local Call. The film lets us explore something deeper than we could in our investigative journalism alone: not only the words being said but also those that are not said, the silence. It is up to all of us to break that silence. — Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor

title: Arnie & Barney
description: In the midst of a severe drought during the hottest summer the meadow has ever faced, streams are drying up, grass is brittle, and the once-bustling insect metropolis teeters on the brink of chaos. For the ants in Captain Pantz’s platoon, the mission is clear: find water and save the community. But there’s one unexpected twist - the hilariously inept Arnie and Barney have decided to tackle the problem themselves. Determined to find water for the meadow and impress their captain, they abandon their post to seek a water source. But what begins as a simple quest quickly spirals into a grand adventure, when the pair encounter a crafty caterpillar mob boss hoarding stolen water, and Hypnita, a scheming mosquito with hypnotic eyes and a thirst for control. As the stakes rise, Arnie and Barney mount a daring rescue to free their platoon from the villains’ grip and restore water to the meadow, hoping that with a mix of luck, chaos, and well-meaning blunders, they can save the day and become the heroes they always dreamed they’d be.

title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
description: In 1972, legendary filmmaker William Greaves gathered an extraordinary group of artists, writers, actors, musicians, and thinkers of the Harlem Renaissance. After more than 50 years, his son David Greaves has completed his breathtaking miracle of a movie.

title: NAZA (15)
description: Cloaked in darkness on the rooftops of Tel Aviv, Israeli journalist Yuval Abraham conducts shattering one-on-one interviews with Israeli soldiers and intelligence personnel.

title: Wildwood
description: The Portland-set story follows Prue McKeel, who enters an enchanted wonderland when her baby brother Mac is taken by a murder of crows into the forest’s depths.

title: ONCE UPON A TIME IN HARLEM
description: August 1972: A reunion of Harlem Renaissance luminaries is held at Duke Ellington’s St. Nicholas Ave. townhouse. Though many of these figures haven’t seen each other in 50 years, sharp memories, vigorous debates, and unsettled scores soon flow through this stunner of a cocktail party, which features (among others): artists Romare Bearden, Aaron Douglas, and Richard Bruce Nugent; composer Eubie Blake; poet Arna Bontemps; photographer James Van Der Zee; and activists Richard B. Moore and Louise Patterson. After organizing and shooting this extraordinary gathering, filmmaker William Greaves (SYMBIOPSYCHOTAXIPLASM: TAKE ONE) was unable to complete the film before his death in 2014. One of the cameramen that day was his son David, who expertly reshaped this never-before-seen, newly-restored footage into “a film for the ages…one of the greatest cinematic works of creative nonfiction that I’ve ever seen.” – Richard Brody, The New Yorker

title: Sense and Sensibility (U) (AD)
description: An irresistible new take on Jane Austen ’s iconic Sense and Sensibility : a charming, witty and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood, starring Daisy Edgar-Jones and Esmé Creed-Miles .

title: THE NICKEL’S PSYCHOTRONIC HALLOWEEN MYSTERY MOVIE MASH - WEEKEND PASS
description:
Two days, eight mystery horror movies from around the world.
Across Halloween and the following day, The Nickel presents four deep-cut psychotronic horror films per day: forgotten exploitation, regional nightmares, video-era mutations, disreputable sleaze and eye-popping oddities that have slipped through the cracks of horror history.
Every title remains secret until showtime. Come for one day or sacrifice yourself to the entire weekend.
Films will screen at 2:00pm, 4:15pm, 6:30pm and 9pm on both Saturday 31st October and Sunday 1st November.
Costumes highly encouraged.

title: Forgotten Island
description: When two best friends are sucked through a magical portal they find themselves menaced by a dangerous creature and in danger of losing the memories that bond them together.

title: Ken Russell's The Devils: The Director's Cut
description: Censored for over half a century, Ken Russell’s film returns in a landmark director’s cut reconstruction that reveals the full power of his original vision. Inspired by the true story of 17th-century priest Urbain Grandier, accused of bewitching a convent of nuns, The Devils lays bare the collusion of church and state through a searing vision of religious persecution, collective hysteria and institutional corruption. The restoration many believed would never happen reaffirms Russell’s incendiary masterpiece as among the most overwhelming and uncompromising achievements in British cinema. Assembled from original camera negative, this 4k restoration is Ken Russell’s 2004 preferred edit. Picture and sound restoration by Warner Bros. Post Production Creative Services, Water Tower Color and Warner Bros. Sound.

title: Ken Russell's The Devils 35mm
description: An enduring masterpiece of cinema starring Oliver Reed and Vanessa Redgrave, THE DEVILS is a prescient epic of obsession and corruption - and a defining work of art from seminal filmmaker Ken Russell. Fully restored and presented uncut and unfiltered as Russell always envisioned, the film screens from a stunning, brand new 35mm print.

title: THE BIRDS
description: Nothing equals THE BIRDS for sheer terror when Alfred Hitchcock unleashes his foul friends in one of his most shocking and memorable masterpieces. As beautiful blonde Melanie Daniels (Tippi Hedren) rolls into Bodega Bay in pursuit of eligible bachelor Mitch Brenner (Rod Taylor), she is inexplicably attacked by a seagull. Suddenly thousands of birds are flocking into town, preying on schoolchildren and residents in a terrifying series of attacks. Soon Mitch and Melanie are fighting for their lives against a deadly force that can’t be explained and can’t be stopped in one of Hollywood’s most horrific films of nature gone berserk.

title: SHAUN THE SHEEP: THE BEAST OF MOSSY BOTTOM
description: SHAUN THE SHEEP: THE BEAST OF MOSSY BOTTOM sees the residents of Mossy Bottom Farm looking forward to Halloween -- until the clumsy Farmer trashes the Flock's beloved pumpkin patch! When Shaun turns MAD SCIENTIST to fix the problem, things rapidly spiral out of control... With The Farmer missing and...

title: Halloween (1978)
description: Fifteen years after murdering his sister on Halloween Night 1963, Michael Myers escapes from a mental hospital and returns to the small town of Haddonfield, Illinois to kill again.

title: On The Road
description: ‘Veneno’, a rebellious young drifter, frequents roadside diners where he sleeps with truck drivers. Urgently needing a ride, he meets ‘Muñeco’, a hard-edged driver who keeps to himself. He convinces Muñeco to take him deep into the hyper-masculine world of long-haul trucking across the north of Mexico. As they travel together and an unexpected intimacy builds between them, shadows from Veneno’s past resurface, putting both their lives at risk. Regular engagement begins Wed, Oct 28 – showtimes to be announced.

title: Obsession
description: You’ve heard the whispers. You’ve seen the hype. Now experience the horror phenomenon that has audiences obsessed. Come see what everyone is talking about…or come back because you love this movie more than anything in the whole f***ing world!

title: I Love Boosters
description: A shoplifter who dreams of designing clothes teams up with her friends to target a ruthless fashion boss in this sci-fi crime comedy.

title: Street Fighter
description: Set in 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu (Andrew Koji) and Ken Masters (Noah Centineo) are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li (Callina Liang) recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don’t, it’s GAME OVER!

description: Three friends attempt to communicate with the spirits occupying a haunted house, and become embroiled in a supernatural adventure.

title: House of Wax
description: Part of our Dark Castle series presented by Justin LaLiberty

title: The History of Concrete
description: Fri, Sep 18: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Edy Modica (actress, comedian, filmmaker), after 4:40 show! Fri, Sep 18: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Rachel Kaly (comedian, writer, actor), after 7:15 show! Sun, Sep 20: Q&A with dir. John Wilson, moderated by Sarah Sherman after 2:10 show! Following the finale of his TV show, filmmaker John Wilson searches for a new creative outlet. After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, he attempts to apply the same formula to a documentary about concrete.

title: Vera
description: A pioneering work of transmasc cinema inspired by the life of Brazilian poet Anderson Bigode Herzer starring Ana Beatriz Nogueira as Bauer, a trans man who struggles to overcome a painful early life via the embrace of art and the love of a sympathetic young librarian (Aida Leiner). “When Caden Mark Gardner and I co-curated Vera as part of the original Masc series in 2022, Caden did some amazing research on the film. Together we determined that it is one of the earliest (and also one of the best) portrayals in world cinema of a transmasculine character. And the film’s protagonist, Bauer (the film’s title is his dead name), shines through as an incredible transmasc hero. As he confidently proclaims to the powers that be, ‘I’m not what everyone thinks I am. You hear me? I’m different. I’m something else. Something else.’” —Series curator Jenni Olson, queer film historian and archivist Introduction by Jenni Olson on Sunday, October 25th Part of Jenni Olson Selects: Mini Masc

title: POLTERGEIST
description: A typical family in a quiet suburb of a normal California faces a frightening ordeal when its home is invaded by a poltergeist. Late one night, 10-year-old Carol Anne Freeling (Heather O’Rourke) hears a voice coming from inside the television set… At first, the spirits that invade the Freeling’s home seem like playful children. But then they turn angry. And when Carol Anne is pulled from this world into another, Steve and Diane Freeling (Craig T. Nelson and JoBeth Williams) turn to an exorcist (Zelda Rubinstein) in this horror classic from director Tobe Hooper and producer and screenwriter Steven Spielberg.​

title: DEATH BECOMES HER
description: Meryl Streep and Goldie Hawn star with Bruce Willis in Robert Zemeckis’ outrageously entertaining comedy about greed, vanity, sex, immortality, life… and death. Isabella Rossellini is a beautiful enchantress who changes their lives—and deaths—forever in this hilarious dark comedy with ground-breaking special effects.

title: SGT. KABUKIMAN NYPD (Lloyd Kaufman in person on Sun, Oct 25!)
description: “When rookie New York City policeman Harry Griswold ends up in the middle of a shootout while attending an evening of kabuki theater, his attempt to save the life of a critically injured performer yields unintended consequences. The dying man bestows his supernatural powers onto Harry, thus rendering him ‘The Chosen One.’ Suddenly finding himself sprouting paper umbrellas and covered in face paint, the formerly clumsy cop is transformed into a crime-fighting superstar, with the help and training of Lotus, daughter of the deceased actor. But Harry’s new gifts also come with a fresh calling as he learns that he alone has the power to defeat the ancient ‘Evil One’ and foil his diabolical plans for bloodthirsty world domination. Mixing high-stakes action, spectacular car stunts, monstrous mutants, and Troma’s signature style of madcap gore and hilarious hijinx, this outrageous late-night TV and video store classic features a who’s who of cult stars, including Joe Fleishaker, Bill Weeden, and Rick Gianasi as Harry Griswold.” –VINEGAR SYNDROME Lloyd Kaufman will be here in person for the screening on Sun, Oct 25 at 6:30, and he'll be joined by actor Bill Weeden!

title: Horror of Dracula
description: Christopher Lee joined Max Schreck and Bela Lugosi in the Screen Vampires Hall of Fame with this, his first appearance as a regally seductive Count Dracula, facing off for the first but far from the last time against Peter Cushing’s Doctor Van Helsing. An infusion of fresh blood—quite literally, in the sanguinary opening credits—for Bram Stoker’s well-thumbed tale of the macabre, by turns elegant and frightfully visceral. Along with The Curse of Frankenstein, Horror of Dracula was decisive in Hammer’s turn to Gothic horror, embraced by thrill-loving audiences around the world, though not the reviewer of the Daily Telegraph, who sniffed: “This British film has an X certificate. This is too good for it. There should be a new certificate—‘S’ for sadistic or just ‘D’ for disgusting.” Part of Terence Fisher: Hammer's Master Smith

title: The Devils
description: Ken Russell’s infamous adaptation of Aldous Huxley’s book, about the apparent possession of a group of nuns after one (Vanessa Redgrave) accuses a priest (Oliver Reed) of collaborating with the devil, is at long last available in its full, uncensored splendor.

title: Fatherland
description: The new offering from Oscar-winner Pawel Pawlikowski Fatherland centres on the relationship between the Nobel Prize-winning writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika, actress, writer and rally driver. In the summer of 1949, at the height of the Cold War, father and daughter embark on a challenging and emotional road trip in a black Buick taking them across a Germany in ruins – from US dominated Frankfurt to Soviet controlled Weimar. Returning home after sixteen years of exile in the US, Thomas Mann has to face not only a divided fatherland, but also deep fracture within his own family.

title: The Edges of Cinema: Book Launch + Panel Discussion
Clayface
description: A shape-shifting creature made of magical clay haunts Gotham City, alternating between villain and ally of Batman. Multiple tragic figures have taken on the Clayface mantle over the years.

title: Maidan (МАЙДАН)
description: Maidan (МАЙДАН). 2014. Netherlands. Written and directed by Sergei Loznitsa. DCP courtesy Atoms & Void. In Ukrainian, Russian; English subtitles. 130 min. Euromaidan, the largest democratic mass movement in Europe since 1989, began in November 2013 when thousands of peaceful demonstrators took to Kyiv’s Maidan Nezalezhnosti (Independence Square) to protest the corrupt, abusive regime of then-President Viktor Yanukovych and his sudden decision not to sign a free trade and political association agreement with the European Union. Every bit the equal of Patricio Guzmán’s landmark The Battle of Chile (1976-79), Sergei Loznitsa’s Maidan is the most cogent and stirring chronicle of this so-called Maidan Uprising, or Revolution of Dignity, from a civil uprising that grew to some one million protestors nationwide to a bloody crackdown that led to an estimated 108 civilian casualties and hundreds more wounded. The revolution culminated in late February, when parliament restored the 2004 Constitution and removed Yanukovych from office, though not before he secretly fled Kyiv and gained asylum in Russia. With Ukraine clawing its way back from the brink of civil war, Vladimir Putin ordered the invasion of the Crimean Peninsula on February 27 and its annexation on March 18, paving the way for the Russo-Ukrainian war.

title: Bride of Frankenstein
description: Openly queer film director James Whale’s gothic masterpiece weaves the artistic style of German Expressionism, a distinctly camp sensibility, and a story of otherness that resonates throughout history. One of the greatest artistic triumphs of the Universal monster empire, this all-time classic features electric performances by Boris Karloff and Elsa Lanchester. Bleak and beautiful, this may be your grandmother’s monster movie, but it’s still fresh and iconic enough to be yours too!

title: The Devils
description: All screenings on a new 35mm print of the 4K restoration of the film. An enduring, singular masterpiece of cinema starring Academy Award-winner Vanessa Redgrave and Oliver Reed, KEN RUSSELL’S THE DEVILS is a prescient epic of obsession and corruption – and a defining work of art from seminal filmmaker Ken Russell. Assembled from the original camera negative, this new 4K restoration presents Ken Russell’s definitive vision of The Devils by referencing the edit he privately constructed in 2004. The film’s sound has been remastered from original English Composite 35mm Mag Film, transferred at 96kHz, plus other original film elements in selected spots as needed. The Picture and Sound restoration was performed by Warner Bros. Post Production Creative Services, Water Tower Color, and Warner Bros. Sound.

title: Primetime (15) (AD)
description: A triumphantly unsettling Robert Pattinson embodies Chris Hansen, host of the 2000s hit To Catch a Predator who sets out to make television history.

title: The Social Reckoning (15) (AD)
description: In this companion piece to The Social Network , screenwriter Aaron Sorkin returns to the Metaverse with a tale of the whistleblower who started the social media reckoning we're seeing play out today.

title: MY UNDESIRABLE FRIENDS: PART II – EXILE: Chapters 4-5
description: When Russia shuts down all independent media, a group of young dissident journalists must flee Moscow so they can keep reporting and not go to prison. In her riveting follow-up to last year’s awards-sweeping MY UNDESIRABLE FRIENDS — LAST AIR IN MOSCOW, Julia Loktev follows these courageous, sharply funny women (and a few men) as they fan out across a dozen countries, to Istanbul, Tbilisi, Prague, Vienna, Amsterdam, New York, and beyond. Over the course of four years, they continue to report the truth to Russians from exile, covering their country’s war crimes, even as they face death threats and are declared extremists and terrorists—as they find new meanings of family, friendship, love, and home far from the country to which they may never return. (Viewers can follow EXILE without first seeing LAST AIR IN MOSCOW.)

title: FATHERLAND
description: From the director of IDA and COLD WAR: FATHERLAND follows Nobel Prize-winning author Thomas Mann (Hanns Zischler, KINGS OF THE ROAD) and his actress daughter Erika (Sandra Hüller, ANATOMY OF A FALL) as they drive across a war-ravaged 1949 Germany. Returning home after years of exile in the U.S. and exuding a superhuman gravitas, Mann finds the Germany he knew to be gone, replaced by a country with contradictory ideologies. Erika, who acts as his travel coordinator and translator, strives to pierce his detached persona while quietly struggling with a family tragedy.

title: Resident Evil (2026)
description: Have a bloody good time in our microcinema as Zach Cregger’s newest horror triumph takes over for Halloween Weekend! From the mind of visionary filmmaker Zach Cregger (Weapons, Barbarian) comes a thrilling — and terrifying — reinvention of the Resident Evil franchise. In an all-new story, Resident Evil follows Bryan (Austin Abrams), a medical courier who unwittingly finds himself in an action-packed, non-stop race for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

title: ONCE UPON A TIME IN HARLEM
description: August 1972: A reunion of Harlem Renaissance luminaries is held at Duke Ellington’s St. Nicholas Ave. townhouse. Though many of these figures haven’t seen each other in 50 years, sharp memories, vigorous debates, and unsettled scores soon flow through this stunner of a cocktail party, which features (among others): artists Romare Bearden, Aaron Douglas, and Richard Bruce Nugent; composer Eubie Blake; poet Arna Bontemps; photographer James Van Der Zee; and activists Richard B. Moore and Louise Patterson.
